options.A: All routes reaching that clause are accepted, since a permit clause with no match conditions matches everything.
options.B: The router raises a configuration error and refuses to link the route map to the BGP neighbor.
options.C: All routes reaching that clause are discarded.
options.D: The routes are discarded and a syslog message is generated.

questions.explanation_es: Una cláusula permit de un route-map que no contiene ninguna sentencia match se considera una coincidencia universal: todas las rutas que llegan a esa cláusula se aceptan, aplicando además cualquier sentencia set que incluya.

questions.name: eBGP
questions.question:
Consider the following route map:
route-map QUESTION deny 10
 match ip address prefix-list PrefixRFC1918
route-map QUESTION permit 20
 set metric 200
What happens to a prefix that does NOT match the PrefixRFC1918 prefix list?

options.A: The prefix is denied because it failed to match sequence 10.
options.B: The prefix is permitted, and Cisco IOS resets its metric to a default value of 100.
options.C: The prefix is permitted and has its metric set to 200, because it falls through to sequence 20, which matches everything.
options.D: The prefix is permitted, but its metric is left unchanged.

questions.explanation_es: La ruta que no coincide con la lista de prefijos PrefixRFC1918 no coincide con la secuencia 10 (deny), por lo que la evaluación continúa con la secuencia 20. Como esa secuencia es un permit sin condiciones de coincidencia, la ruta se permite y se le aplica la sentencia set metric 200.

questions.name: eBGP
questions.question: Which statement is correct regarding combining a BGP AS_Path filter (filter-list) with a prefix-list filter on the same neighbor?

options.A: A prefix-list always overrides and disables any AS_Path filter-list configured on the same neighbor.
options.B: Cisco IOS allows only one type of inbound filter per neighbor, so an AS_Path filter-list and a prefix-list cannot both be configured on it.
options.C: An AS_Path filter-list and a prefix-list can both be applied to the same neighbor and direction at the same time; a route must pass both to be accepted.
options.D: AS_Path filter-lists can only be applied globally to a BGP process and never to an individual neighbor.

questions.explanation_es: Un filtro de AS_Path (filter-list) y una lista de prefijos (prefix-list) son mecanismos de filtrado independientes y pueden aplicarse simultáneamente al mismo vecino y en la misma dirección; para que una ruta sea aceptada debe superar ambos filtros.

questions.name: eBGP
questions.question: Which of the following is not an actual well-known BGP community?

options.A: Internet
options.B: Private_Route
options.C: No_Export
options.D: No_Advertise

questions.explanation_es: No_Advertise, No_Export e Internet son comunidades BGP well-known reconocidas y estandarizadas. Private_Route no es una comunidad well-known definida; es un nombre inventado que no existe en la especificación de BGP.

questions.name: eBGP
questions.question: In the Cisco BGP best-path selection process, which attribute is evaluated second, right after weight?

options.A: Weight
options.B: Multi-Exit Discriminator (MED)
options.C: Local preference
options.D: Origin

questions.explanation_es: En el algoritmo de selección de mejor ruta de BGP en Cisco, tras comparar el weight (el primer criterio, local al router), el segundo criterio evaluado es la preferencia local (local preference), que se comparte entre los routers del mismo AS.

questions.name: eBGP
questions.question: By default, under what condition does a Cisco BGP router compare the MED (Multi-Exit Discriminator) attribute between candidate paths?

options.A: Only when the paths were received from neighbors in the same neighboring AS, unless bgp always-compare-med is configured.
options.B: MED is never used unless BGP confederations are configured.
options.C: Only when the paths were received from different autonomous systems.
options.D: MED is compared for every path by default, regardless of the originating AS.

questions.explanation_es: De forma predeterminada, Cisco IOS solo compara el atributo MED entre rutas recibidas del mismo AS vecino; para comparar el MED de rutas provenientes de AS vecinos distintos es necesario habilitar el comando bgp always-compare-med.

questions.name: eBGP
questions.question: Which BGP message type is used both to advertise newly reachable routes and to withdraw previously advertised routes?

options.A: Keepalive
options.B: Open
options.C: Notification
options.D: Update

questions.explanation_es: El mensaje BGP Update se utiliza tanto para anunciar rutas nuevas y alcanzables como para retirar (withdraw) rutas previamente anunciadas que ya no son válidas.

questions.name: eBGP
questions.question: In which BGP finite-state-machine state do peers begin exchanging routing information using Update messages?

options.A: Active
options.B: Connect
options.C: Established
options.D: OpenConfirm

questions.explanation_es: En el estado Established de la máquina de estados de BGP, la sesión ya está completamente establecida y los vecinos comienzan a intercambiar información de enrutamiento mediante mensajes Update.

questions.name: Multicast
questions.question: Which traffic delivery model most accurately characterizes IP multicast forwarding?

options.A: Every host exchanging data with every other host simultaneously
options.B: One sender exchanging data with a single specific receiver
options.C: One sender flooding data to every host on the network
options.D: One sender delivering data to a defined set of interested receivers

questions.explanation_es: El multicast IP se describe como un modelo "uno-a-muchos" (one-to-many), donde una fuente envía tráfico solo a los receptores que han manifestado interés en unirse al grupo, a diferencia del broadcast que llega a todos los hosts.

questions.name: Multicast
questions.question: Which two protocols form the core building blocks that make IP multicast routing and group membership possible? (Choose two.)

options.A: Protocol Independent Multicast (PIM)
options.B: Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD)
options.C: Internet Group Management Protocol (IGMP)
options.D: Open Shortest Path First (OSPF)

questions.explanation_es: PIM construye y mantiene los árboles de distribución multicast entre routers, mientras que IGMP permite que los hosts informen a su router local sobre su interés en unirse a un grupo multicast; ambos son indispensables para el funcionamiento básico de multicast.

questions.name: Multicast
questions.question: According to RFC 2365, which multicast address block is reserved for administratively (organization-local) scoped use and is never assigned globally by IANA?
questions.explanation_es: El bloque 239.0.0.0/8 está reservado por la RFC 2365 para uso local u organizacional, de forma similar a las direcciones privadas de la RFC 1918; no se asigna globalmente, por lo que los administradores pueden reutilizarlo libremente dentro de su propio dominio.

questions.name: Multicast
questions.question: What are the fixed first 24 bits of every Ethernet multicast MAC address derived from an IPv4 multicast group address?
questions.explanation_es: Los primeros 24 bits de toda dirección MAC multicast IPv4 están fijados en 01:00:5E; los 23 bits restantes se copian directamente de los 23 bits de orden inferior de la dirección IP multicast del grupo.

questions.name: Multicast
questions.question: How can a host begin receiving traffic for a multicast group without waiting for the next periodic query from its router?

options.A: By sending an unsolicited IGMP membership report for the group
options.B: By waiting passively for a PIM join to arrive from the RP
options.C: By sending a gratuitous ARP reply for the group's mapped MAC address
options.D: By sending an ICMP router solicitation message

questions.explanation_es: A partir de IGMPv2, un host puede enviar un reporte de membresía IGMP no solicitado (unsolicited report) hacia la dirección del grupo en cuanto desea unirse, sin necesidad de esperar la consulta periódica del router.

questions.name: Multicast
questions.question: What functional capability did IGMPv3 add that IGMPv2 lacks?

options.A: Support for source-filtered membership reports (include/exclude source lists)
options.B: A shorter default query interval of 60 seconds
options.C: The ability for the router to send periodic membership queries
options.D: The ability to snoop multicast traffic at Layer 2

questions.explanation_es: IGMPv3 introdujo reportes de membresía con filtrado por fuente (listas include/exclude), lo que permite a un host especificar de qué fuentes desea o no recibir tráfico, una capacidad necesaria para SSM que IGMPv2 no posee.

questions.name: Multicast
questions.question: Which statement correctly describes IGMPv3's relationship to earlier IGMP versions and multicast service models?

options.A: IGMPv3 routers can still support IGMPv1 and IGMPv2 hosts, and IGMPv3 can also be used with ASM
options.B: IGMPv3 requires every host to be manually configured with the RP address
options.C: IGMPv3 replaced PIM as the multicast routing protocol
options.D: IGMPv3 works only with SSM and cannot interoperate with IGMPv1/v2 hosts

questions.explanation_es: IGMPv3 es retrocompatible: un router con IGMPv3 puede seguir interoperando con hosts que usan IGMPv1 o IGMPv2, y aunque IGMPv3 es imprescindible para SSM, también puede emplearse en el modelo ASM tradicional.

questions.name: Multicast
questions.question: Which feature prevents a Layer 2 switch from flooding multicast frames out every port in a VLAN?

options.A: IGMP snooping
options.B: Storm control on broadcast traffic
options.C: Spanning Tree PortFast
options.D: Unicast MAC flooding protection

questions.explanation_es: El IGMP snooping permite que el switch examine los mensajes IGMP y construya una tabla de puertos con hosts interesados, reenviando el tráfico multicast solo a esos puertos en lugar de inundar toda la VLAN.

questions.name: Multicast
questions.question: Which two statements accurately describe the shortest path tree (SPT) and rendezvous point tree (RPT) used by PIM-SM? (Choose two.)

options.A: The SPT is a shared tree rooted at the rendezvous point
options.B: The SPT is rooted at the multicast source
options.C: The RPT is rooted at the multicast source
options.D: The RPT is a shared tree rooted at the rendezvous point

questions.explanation_es: El SPT (shortest path tree) tiene como raíz a la propia fuente multicast y ofrece la ruta más corta hacia los receptores, mientras que el RPT (rendezvous point tree) es un árbol compartido cuya raíz es el rendezvous point (RP), usado por múltiples fuentes hacia el mismo grupo.

questions.name: Multicast
questions.question: After the last-hop router (LHR) receives an IGMP membership report from a directly connected receiver, what does it do next?

options.A: It floods the join request out all PIM-enabled interfaces
options.B: It sends a PIM join message directly toward the source
options.C: It sends a PIM register message toward the source
options.D: It sends a PIM join message toward the rendezvous point

questions.explanation_es: El LHR, al recibir un join IGMP de un receptor, genera un PIM join (*,G) que envía hacia el RP para engancharse al árbol compartido (RPT) y comenzar a recibir el tráfico del grupo.

questions.name: Multicast
questions.question: When a multicast source connected to the first-hop router (FHR) starts sending traffic but no receivers have joined yet, what does the FHR do?

options.A: It floods the encapsulated data as multicast register messages to all PIM neighbors
options.B: It drops the traffic until a PIM join is received from a downstream router
options.C: It encapsulates the multicast data inside PIM register messages and unicasts them to the RP until it gets a register-stop
options.D: It waits for the RP to unicast a register message confirming interested receivers exist

questions.explanation_es: El FHR encapsula el tráfico multicast dentro de mensajes PIM register y los envía en unicast al RP; este proceso continúa hasta que el RP responde con un register-stop, momento en el que el FHR deja de encapsular y unicastear el tráfico.

questions.name: Multicast
questions.question: Which group-to-RP mapping mechanism was originally developed by Cisco, prior to the standardized Bootstrap Router mechanism?

options.A: Bootstrap Router (BSR)
options.B: Anycast-RP
options.C: Auto-RP
options.D: Static RP configuration

questions.explanation_es: Auto-RP es un mecanismo propietario de Cisco creado antes de que se estandarizara BSR (definido en la RFC 5059) para automatizar el descubrimiento y la distribución de la información de mapeo grupo-a-RP entre los routers PIM-SM.

questions.name: Multicast
questions.question: Which statement about rendezvous points (RPs) in PIM dense mode (PIM-DM) is correct?

options.A: PIM-DM does not use RPs at all, since it floods traffic and then prunes unwanted branches
options.B: PIM-DM uses a single RP elected dynamically via BSR
options.C: PIM-DM requires at least one RP to build the initial flood-and-prune tree
options.D: PIM-DM requires two RPs configured in an active/standby pair

questions.explanation_es: PIM en modo denso (PIM-DM) no utiliza rendezvous points; en su lugar, inunda el tráfico multicast a toda la red y luego poda (prune) las ramas hacia donde no hay receptores interesados. El concepto de RP es exclusivo de PIM-SM.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: Which three of the following are commonly cited as leading causes of QoS problems on a network? (Choose three.)

options.A: Packet loss
options.B: Excessive latency and jitter
options.C: Insufficient available bandwidth
options.D: Use of copper cabling instead of fiber

questions.explanation_es: Los problemas de calidad de servicio se atribuyen principalmente a la falta de ancho de banda suficiente, a la latencia y variación de retardo (jitter) excesivas, y a la pérdida de paquetes. El tipo de medio físico, como el uso de cableado de cobre en lugar de fibra, no es en sí mismo una de las causas típicas que motivan la implementación de QoS.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: Which three of the following are classified as fixed (constant) components of end-to-end network delay? (Choose three.)

options.A: Queuing delay
options.B: Propagation delay
options.C: Processing delay
options.D: Serialization delay

questions.explanation_es: El retardo de propagación, el retardo de serialización y el retardo de procesamiento se consideran componentes fijos del retardo total, ya que dependen de factores constantes como la distancia, la velocidad del enlace y la arquitectura del dispositivo. El retardo de encolamiento, en cambio, es variable porque depende del nivel de congestión en un momento dado, y es precisamente esa variabilidad la que produce el jitter.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: Which of the following is not one of the three QoS implementation models?

options.A: Differentiated Services (DiffServ)
options.B: Integrated Services (IntServ)
options.C: Expedited Forwarding
options.D: Best effort

questions.explanation_es: Los tres modelos de implementación de QoS son mejor esfuerzo (best effort), servicios integrados (IntServ) y servicios diferenciados (DiffServ). Expedited Forwarding no es un modelo de QoS, sino un comportamiento por salto (per-hop behavior, PHB) definido dentro del modelo DiffServ.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: Which QoS implementation model requires end hosts and network devices to use a signaling protocol to reserve resources for a flow before transmitting?

options.A: Integrated Services (IntServ)
options.B: Best effort
options.C: RSVP
options.D: Differentiated Services (DiffServ)

questions.explanation_es: El modelo de Servicios Integrados (IntServ) exige que las aplicaciones señalicen sus requisitos a la red y reserven recursos extremo a extremo antes de enviar tráfico, utilizando el protocolo RSVP (Resource Reservation Protocol) para dicha señalización. RSVP es el protocolo que se emplea para lograrlo, pero no es en sí mismo un modelo de QoS.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: Which QoS implementation model is the most widely deployed in modern enterprise networks?

options.A: Integrated Services (IntServ)
options.B: Differentiated Services (DiffServ)
options.C: Best effort
options.D: RSVP-based reservation

questions.explanation_es: El modelo de Servicios Diferenciados (DiffServ) es el más utilizado en las redes actuales porque clasifica el tráfico en un número reducido de clases y aplica un tratamiento por salto (PHB) a cada una, sin requerir señalización de extremo a extremo ni el mantenimiento de estado por flujo, lo que lo hace mucho más escalable que IntServ.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: In the Modular QoS CLI (MQC), which command is used, while inside policy-map configuration mode, to reference a previously defined class map?

options.A: class-map match-any class-map-name
options.B: policy-map class-map-name
options.C: match class class-map-name
options.D: class class-map-name

questions.explanation_es: Dentro del modo de configuración de policy-map, el comando class class-map-name se utiliza para hacer referencia a un class-map ya creado y así aplicarle acciones de calidad de servicio, como marcado, policiamiento o asignación de ancho de banda. El comando class-map se usa en un contexto distinto, en el modo de configuración global, para definir los criterios de clasificación.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: Which command attaches a policy map to an interface within the Modular QoS CLI framework?

options.A: apply-policy output policy-map-name
options.B: policy-map input policy-map-name
options.C: service-policy {input | output} policy-map-name
options.D: class-map input policy-map-name

questions.explanation_es: El comando service-policy, seguido de la palabra clave input u output y el nombre del policy-map, es el que se aplica en modo de configuración de interfaz para asociar una política de QoS ya definida al tráfico entrante o saliente de esa interfaz.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: True or false: Traffic classification for QoS purposes should ideally be performed in the core of the network.

options.A: False
options.B: True
options.C: Only when trust boundaries are disabled
options.D: Only on core routers with hardware-based CEF

questions.explanation_es: La clasificación del tráfico debe realizarse lo más cerca posible del origen del tráfico, es decir, en el borde de la red (por ejemplo, en el switch de acceso o en el propio endpoint), y no en el núcleo. Clasificar en el borde permite que todos los dispositivos posteriores del trayecto puedan aplicar el tratamiento adecuado basándose en la marca ya asignada, sin tener que reexaminar el paquete completo en cada salto.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: True or false: The Differentiated Services (DS) field in the IP header is an 8-bit DSCP field that provides 64 possible classification values (0 through 63).

options.A: True, but only in IPv6 headers
options.B: True
options.C: True, but only the 4 most significant bits are used
options.D: False

questions.explanation_es: El campo DS (Differentiated Services) ocupa 8 bits del encabezado IP, pero el propio DSCP (Differentiated Services Code Point) solo utiliza los 6 bits más significativos de ese campo, lo cual sí produce 64 valores posibles (0 a 63); los 2 bits restantes se reservan para ECN (Explicit Congestion Notification). Por lo tanto, es incorrecto describir el campo completo de 8 bits como si fuera únicamente el DSCP.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: Which two MQC configuration snippets correctly mark traffic matched by class VOIP-TELEPHONY with DSCP EF? (Choose two.)

options.A: policy-map INBOUND-MARKING-POLICY / class VOIP-TELEPHONY / mark dscp ef
options.B: policy-map INBOUND-MARKING-POLICY / class VOIP-TELEPHONY / set ip dscp ef
options.C: policy-map INBOUND-MARKING-POLICY / class VOIP-TELEPHONY / set ip precedence ef
options.D: policy-map INBOUND-MARKING-POLICY / class VOIP-TELEPHONY / set dscp ef

questions.explanation_es: Tanto set ip dscp ef como set dscp ef son sintaxis válidas de la Modular QoS CLI para marcar el tráfico coincidente con el valor DSCP EF (Expedited Forwarding). El comando mark dscp no existe en la MQC, y el comando set ip precedence no acepta la palabra clave ef, ya que la precedencia IP usa una escala numérica de 0 a 7, no las etiquetas de nombre que emplea DSCP.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: Which traffic-conditioning mechanism drops or re-marks packets that exceed a configured traffic rate?

options.A: Policers
options.B: Weighted round robin (WRR)
options.C: Class-based weighted fair queuing (CBWFQ)
options.D: Shapers

questions.explanation_es: Los policiadores (policers) miden el tráfico contra una tasa configurada y, cuando el tráfico excede esa tasa, lo descartan o lo remarcan con un valor de menor prioridad. Los conformadores (shapers), en cambio, retrasan el tráfico excedente almacenándolo en una cola en lugar de descartarlo.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: In traffic-policing terminology, what does the variable Tc represent?

options.A: The committed time interval used to measure the committed burst
options.B: A counter used strictly for traffic-control accounting
options.C: The number of unused token credits carried over from the previous interval
options.D: The size, in bytes, of the committed burst (Bc) bucket

questions.explanation_es: Tc representa el intervalo de tiempo comprometido (committed time interval) que se utiliza en los algoritmos de policiamiento de tráfico, y se calcula típicamente como Bc dividido entre el CIR (tasa de información comprometida). Es el periodo sobre el cual se mide si el tráfico respeta la tasa comprometida.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: Which two congestion-management (queuing) mechanisms are recommended for modern networks carrying converged voice, video, and data traffic? (Choose two.)

options.A: Low-latency queuing (LLQ)
options.B: Weighted random early detection (WRED)
options.C: Class-based weighted fair queuing (CBWFQ)
options.D: Legacy priority queuing (PQ)

questions.explanation_es: CBWFQ y LLQ son los mecanismos de gestión de congestión recomendados para redes convergentes modernas, ya que combinan un reparto justo del ancho de banda entre clases con una cola de prioridad estricta para el tráfico sensible a la latencia. La cola de prioridad clásica (PQ) no se recomienda porque puede dejar sin servicio a las colas de menor prioridad, y WRED es en realidad un mecanismo de prevención de congestión, no de gestión de colas.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: Which congestion-avoidance mechanism is recommended for modern rich-media networks?

options.A: Weighted random early detection (WRED)
options.B: Plain random early detection (RED)
options.C: First-in, first-out (FIFO) queuing
options.D: Tail drop

questions.explanation_es: WRED es el mecanismo de prevención de congestión recomendado porque descarta paquetes de forma selectiva según su prioridad (por ejemplo, según el valor DSCP) antes de que la cola se llene por completo, evitando así la sincronización global de TCP. El descarte por cola llena (tail drop) y el RED simple no diferencian entre clases de tráfico, y FIFO ni siquiera implementa gestión de colas por clase.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question:
Given the configuration below, which two statements correctly describe the effect of "percent 30"? (Choose two.)
policy-map QUEUING
 class VOIP
  priority level 1 percent 30

options.A: Priority traffic is allowed to exceed 30 percent whenever additional bandwidth is available
options.B: The priority class can never consume more than 30 percent of the interface bandwidth, even when spare capacity exists
options.C: The priority queue is policed to 30 percent of interface bandwidth at all times, regardless of congestion
options.D: The priority queue is capped at 30 percent only while the interface is congested

questions.explanation_es: El comando priority configura una cola de prioridad estricta que Cisco siempre policía a la tasa configurada (en este caso, el 30 por ciento del ancho de banda de la interfaz), tanto si hay congestión como si no la hay. Este policiamiento constante existe precisamente para evitar que el tráfico de la cola de prioridad monopolice el enlace y deje sin ancho de banda a las demás clases, por lo que dicho tráfico nunca puede superar el 30 por ciento configurado, incluso si sobra capacidad disponible.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: Which type of network delay accounts for the time a router or switch takes to move a packet from an input interface to the output queue of the outbound interface?

options.A: Serialization delay
options.B: Propagation delay
options.C: Processing delay
options.D: Queuing delay

questions.explanation_es: El retardo de procesamiento es el tiempo fijo que le toma a un dispositivo de red tomar un paquete de una interfaz de entrada y colocarlo en la cola de salida de la interfaz correspondiente, y depende de factores como la velocidad de la CPU, el modo de conmutación de paquetes y la carga del dispositivo.

questions.name: QoS
questions.question: Which QoS process examines fields within a packet to distinguish one type of traffic from another so it can be treated differently downstream?

options.A: Shaping
options.B: Policing
options.C: Marking
options.D: Classification

questions.explanation_es: La clasificación es el proceso de QoS encargado de examinar campos del paquete, como direcciones, puertos o valores existentes de DSCP, para distinguir un tipo de tráfico de otro y determinar qué tratamiento diferenciado debe recibir. El marcado, el policiamiento y el conformado son acciones posteriores que se aplican una vez que el tráfico ya ha sido clasificado.

questions.name: NTP/PTP
questions.question: In NTP, what term describes the numeric value indicating how many hops a device is from an authoritative reference clock, used to gauge how trustworthy that time source is?

options.A: Poll interval
options.B: Root dispersion
options.C: Stratum
options.D: Administrative distance

questions.explanation_es: El estrato (stratum) indica la distancia jerárquica de un dispositivo respecto a la fuente de tiempo autorizada, como un reloj atómico. Un número de estrato más bajo implica una fuente más confiable y cercana a la referencia original.

questions.name: NTP/PTP
questions.question: An NTP client has been configured to reference three different NTP servers at the same time. Which statement best describes how the client actually uses these servers to set its clock?

options.A: It synchronizes to only one selected server at a time, chosen using criteria such as stratum and clock stability
options.B: It averages the time reported by all configured servers into a single value
options.C: It always uses the first server listed in the configuration and ignores the others unless that one fails
options.D: It alternates between the servers on a fixed round-robin schedule

questions.explanation_es: Aunque un cliente NTP puede consultar varios servidores, el algoritmo de selección de NTP elige un único servidor de sistema (system peer) para sincronizar el reloj, basándose en el estrato, la estabilidad y otros criterios; no promedia ni alterna entre todos ellos por turnos.

questions.name: NTP/PTP
questions.question: What is the main benefit of configuring a peer association between two NTP servers, instead of a simple client-server relationship?

options.A: It lets both devices stay synchronized with each other and provides redundancy if one of them loses contact with its higher-stratum source
options.B: It forces both devices to become stratum 1 references regardless of their actual hardware clock
options.C: It allows both devices to share a single IP address for all NTP queries
options.D: It removes the need for a stratum hierarchy between the two devices

questions.explanation_es: Cuando dos servidores NTP se configuran como peers, ambos pueden mantenerse sincronizados entre sí y ofrecer redundancia: si uno pierde el acceso a su fuente de estrato superior, todavía puede obtener una referencia de tiempo razonable a través del otro peer.

questions.name: NAT/PAT
questions.question: Which command should be used on a Cisco IOS router to display the currently active NAT translation entries?

options.A: show ip nat translations
options.B: show xlate
options.C: show nat table
options.D: show ip translations

questions.explanation_es: El comando show ip nat translations muestra la tabla de traducciones NAT activas en un router con Cisco IOS. El comando show xlate corresponde a dispositivos de seguridad como ASA, no a routers IOS.

questions.name: NAT/PAT
questions.question: A company uses the private range 10.0.0.0/8 internally. A workstation with address 10.1.1.1 sends traffic to the Internet through a NAT-enabled edge router. From the router's NAT perspective, this original 10.1.1.1 address is classified as which type of address?

options.A: Inside global
options.B: Inside local
options.C: Outside local
options.D: Outside global

questions.explanation_es: La dirección inside local es la dirección IP asignada al host dentro de la red privada, tal como aparece antes de aplicar la traducción NAT. La dirección inside global es la que representa a ese mismo host una vez traducida para salir a Internet.

questions.name: NAT/PAT
questions.question: By default, how long does a Cisco router keep a dynamic NAT translation entry for a TCP connection before removing it from the translation table due to inactivity?

options.A: 12 hours
options.B: 1 hour
options.C: 24 hours
options.D: 4 hours

questions.explanation_es: El temporizador de expiración predeterminado para las traducciones NAT dinámicas de conexiones TCP es de 24 horas; transcurrido ese tiempo sin actividad, la entrada se elimina de la tabla de traducciones.

questions.name: NAT/PAT
questions.question: Which global configuration command changes the default idle timeout applied to dynamic NAT translation entries?

options.A: ip nat pool timeout seconds
options.B: ip nat translation timeout seconds
options.C: nat translation-timeout seconds
options.D: ip nat inside timeout seconds

questions.explanation_es: El comando ip nat translation timeout seconds permite modificar el valor predeterminado de 24 horas que se usa para expirar las entradas dinámicas de traducción NAT.

questions.name: HSRP/VRRP
questions.question: Which two limitations of a typical host's default-gateway setup are addressed by first-hop redundancy protocols (FHRPs) such as HSRP, VRRP, and GLBP? (Choose two.)

options.A: Hosts typically reach their default gateway through a static route entry that does not react automatically to a gateway outage
options.B: Hosts must run a link-state routing protocol to learn about every available gateway on the segment
options.C: Hosts are usually configured with only a single default gateway and have no built-in way to fail over to a backup
options.D: Hosts must run a distance-vector routing protocol to pick the best gateway

questions.explanation_es: Los hosts normalmente se configuran con una única puerta de enlace predeterminada, a menudo mediante una ruta estática, sin ningún mecanismo propio para detectar una falla y cambiar a otra puerta de enlace. Los FHRP resuelven esto presentando una IP virtual respaldada por varios routers que se turnan el reenvío del tráfico.

questions.name: HSRP/VRRP
questions.question: Which two first-hop redundancy protocols are Cisco-proprietary rather than open industry standards? (Choose two.)

options.A: ODR
options.B: HSRP
options.C: VRRP
options.D: GLBP

questions.explanation_es: HSRP y GLBP son protocolos propietarios de Cisco. VRRP es un estándar abierto definido por el IETF, y ODR (On-Demand Routing) ni siquiera es un protocolo de redundancia de primer salto.

questions.name: HSRP/VRRP
questions.question: Which interface configuration command assigns 10.1.1.1 as the virtual IP address for HSRP group 1?

options.A: hsrp 1 vip 10.1.1.1
options.B: standby ip 1 10.1.1.1
options.C: hsrp 1 ip 10.1.1.1
options.D: standby 1 ip 10.1.1.1

questions.explanation_es: El comando standby 1 ip 10.1.1.1 configura la dirección IP virtual del grupo HSRP 1 en la interfaz. La sintaxis de HSRP usa la palabra clave standby, no hsrp.

questions.name: HSRP/VRRP
questions.question: Which first-hop redundancy protocol natively provides load balancing of outbound traffic across multiple gateway routers while presenting a single virtual IP address to hosts?

options.A: ODR
options.B: HSRP
options.C: GLBP
options.D: VRRP

questions.explanation_es: GLBP ofrece balanceo de carga nativo: asigna distintas direcciones MAC virtuales a los distintos routers miembros de un mismo grupo, de modo que los hosts distribuyen su tráfico entre varios gateways activos simultáneamente. HSRP y VRRP mantienen un solo router activo/maestro por grupo a la vez.

questions.name: HSRP/VRRP
questions.question: In VRRP terminology, which router role performs the same function as the active router in an HSRP group?

options.A: Backup
options.B: Primary
options.C: Standby
options.D: Master

questions.explanation_es: El router master de VRRP cumple la misma función que el router activo en HSRP: es el que reenvía el tráfico destinado a la IP virtual en condiciones normales de operación.

questions.name: VRF
questions.question: When you deploy path isolation with VRF-based virtualization on a network device, which two planes of operation are being virtualized? (Choose two.)

options.A: Data plane
options.B: Management plane
options.C: Control plane
options.D: Physical plane

questions.explanation_es: VRF virtualiza tanto el plano de control (tablas de enrutamiento independientes) como el plano de datos (tablas de reenvío independientes) para cada instancia; el plano de gestión normalmente permanece compartido en VRF-Lite.

questions.name: VRF
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the core components that make up a VRF instance?

options.A: An IP routing table
options.B: A derived forwarding table
options.C: The interface(s) assigned to the instance
options.D: An access control list bound to the instance

questions.explanation_es: Una instancia VRF se compone de una tabla de enrutamiento IP, una tabla de reenvío derivada y las interfaces asignadas; una ACL no es un componente intrínseco de la instancia VRF, aunque se pueda aplicar por separado.

questions.name: VRF
questions.question: Which plane of operation is responsible for the protocols, databases, and tables used to compute loop-free paths and make forwarding decisions?

options.A: Management plane
options.B: Services plane
options.C: Control plane
options.D: Data plane

questions.explanation_es: El plano de control incluye los protocolos, bases de datos y tablas (como las de enrutamiento) que se usan para calcular rutas libres de bucles y tomar decisiones de reenvío.

questions.name: VRF
questions.question: True or false: VRF-Lite provides genuine separation of the control and data planes between virtual networks on the same device.

options.A: This is true only when combined with MPLS
options.B: Only the data plane is separated, not the control plane
options.C: False
options.D: True

questions.explanation_es: VRF-Lite crea planos de control y de datos independientes para cada instancia, de modo que no hay comunicación entre VRFs distintos a menos que se permita explícitamente, por ejemplo mediante route leaking.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: When configuring a point-to-point GRE tunnel interface, which two of the following configuration items are optional rather than mandatory?

options.A: tunnel mode
options.B: tunnel destination
options.C: keepalive
options.D: tunnel source

questions.explanation_es: El modo del túnel (tunnel mode) tiene GRE sobre IP como valor por defecto, y los keepalives son opcionales; en cambio, tunnel source y tunnel destination son obligatorios para que el túnel se levante.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: True or false: GRE was originally developed to let networks carry protocols that could not be natively routed across an IP backbone.

options.A: False, GRE was originally created specifically to encapsulate IPX and AppleTalk traffic between Cisco routers, not as a general-purpose, protocol-agnostic tunneling mechanism for arbitrary payloads
options.B: False
options.C: True, but only for IPv6 traffic
options.D: True

questions.explanation_es: GRE se creó originalmente para permitir el transporte de protocolos heredados y no enrutables de forma nativa, como SNA, encapsulándolos dentro de paquetes IP para cruzar una red troncal IP.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: Which of the following should generally NOT be advertised dynamically via an IGP running inside a GRE tunnel?

options.A: Loopback interfaces used by internal networks
options.B: The IP address assigned to the GRE tunnel interface itself
options.C: Connected LAN interfaces
options.D: The tunnel source interface or its underlying IP address

questions.explanation_es: Si la dirección o interfaz de origen del túnel se anuncia dinámicamente por el mismo protocolo que corre dentro del túnel, se puede generar un problema de enrutamiento recursivo que tumba el túnel.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: Which two packet transport modes are defined for IPsec?

options.A: Tunnel mode
options.B: Transparent mode
options.C: Crypto mode
options.D: Transport mode

questions.explanation_es: IPsec define el modo túnel, que encapsula el paquete IP completo, y el modo transporte, que cifra solo la carga útil manteniendo la cabecera IP original.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: Which two encryption algorithms are now considered weak and should be avoided in modern IPsec deployments?

options.A: AES-GCM
options.B: 3DES
options.C: DES
options.D: AES

questions.explanation_es: DES y 3DES tienen longitudes de clave o diseños que ya se consideran débiles frente a ataques modernos; AES y AES-GCM son los algoritmos recomendados actualmente.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: In IKEv1, which exchange negotiates the actual IPsec data-plane security association after the ISAKMP SA has already been established?

options.A: Main mode
options.B: Quick mode
options.C: Aggressive mode
options.D: CREATE_CHILD_SA

questions.explanation_es: Quick mode es el intercambio de la fase 2 de IKEv1 que negocia la SA de IPsec real de datos, apoyándose en la SA ISAKMP ya creada en la fase 1 mediante main mode o aggressive mode.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: Because GRE adds extra header overhead to every encapsulated packet, which interface parameter often needs adjustment to avoid fragmentation issues along the tunnel path?

options.A: The tunnel checksum
options.B: The bandwidth
options.C: The MTU
options.D: The keepalive interval

questions.explanation_es: GRE agrega al menos 24 bytes de sobrecarga, así que a menudo hay que ajustar la MTU, o la MSS de TCP, en la interfaz de túnel para evitar fragmentación.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: Which IPsec security service ensures that data was not altered or tampered with while in transit?

options.A: Anti-replay protection
options.B: Data integrity
options.C: Confidentiality
options.D: Peer authentication

questions.explanation_es: La integridad de datos garantiza, mediante un hash, que la información no fue modificada en tránsito; la confidencialidad se logra con cifrado y es un servicio distinto.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: Which of the following statements about GRE tunnels is NOT actually true?

options.A: GRE can carry routing protocol traffic across the tunnel
options.B: GRE has weak native security features
options.C: GRE tunnels are stateful and track the remote peer's status
options.D: GRE can encapsulate virtually any Layer 3 protocol

questions.explanation_es: Los túneles GRE son sin estado, stateless: el extremo del túnel no mantiene información sobre la disponibilidad del extremo remoto, al contrario de lo que afirma la opcion C.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT required to bring up a basic GRE tunnel?

options.A: A dynamic routing protocol running over the tunnel
options.B: A configured tunnel destination
options.C: A configured tunnel source
options.D: An IP address on the tunnel interface

questions.explanation_es: Un túnel GRE básico solo necesita dirección IP, origen y destino configurados; ejecutar un protocolo de enrutamiento dinámico sobre el túnel es opcional.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: What do the transit (intermediate) routers along the underlay path between two GRE tunnel endpoints do with the tunneled traffic?

options.A: They forward the packet based only on the outer IP header
options.B: They decapsulate the GRE header before forwarding
options.C: They inspect and route based on the encapsulated payload
options.D: They re-encapsulate the packet with a new GRE header

questions.explanation_es: Los routers de tránsito solo examinan la cabecera IP exterior para reenviar el paquete hacia el destino del túnel; no procesan ni decapsulan la carga GRE interna.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: Which VPN technology dynamically builds IPsec tunnels between spoke sites on demand, without requiring a permanently configured tunnel to every peer?

options.A: A dedicated point-to-point GRE tunnel over IPsec
options.B: A static IPsec VTI
options.C: DMVPN
options.D: Cisco FlexVPN with only static crypto maps

questions.explanation_es: DMVPN utiliza NHRP para descubrir dinámicamente a los pares y levantar túneles IPsec spoke-to-spoke o spoke-to-hub bajo demanda, sin necesidad de túneles permanentes preconfigurados hacia cada sitio.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: Which Cisco VPN solution acts as a unifying framework capable of implementing site-to-site, hub-and-spoke, and remote-access VPNs under a common IKEv2-based configuration model?

options.A: Classic crypto maps
options.B: Static VTI deployments only
options.C: GRE tunnels secured with static crypto maps
options.D: Cisco FlexVPN

questions.explanation_es: Cisco FlexVPN es una solución unificada basada en IKEv2 que simplifica y consolida el despliegue de distintos tipos de VPN bajo un mismo modelo de configuración.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: Built-in support for NAT traversal (NAT-T) was introduced as a native capability of which key management protocol version?

options.A: IKEv2
options.B: AH
options.C: IKEv1
options.D: ESP

questions.explanation_es: IKEv2 incorporó de forma nativa el soporte de NAT traversal, simplificando el establecimiento de túneles IPsec cuando hay dispositivos NAT en el camino.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: Which technology provides multi-hop path isolation, as opposed to hop-by-hop isolation, for extending virtual networks across an IP infrastructure?

options.A: 802.1Q trunking
options.B: Static routing between VRF instances
options.C: Multipoint GRE (mGRE)
options.D: Per-hop VRF-Lite with subinterfaces

questions.explanation_es: El GRE multipunto, mGRE, permite el aislamiento de rutas de múltiples saltos, a diferencia de 802.1Q, que se limita al aislamiento salto a salto entre dispositivos Capa 3 adyacentes.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: Which IP protocol number is used to identify GRE-encapsulated packets?

options.A: IP protocol 47
options.B: IP protocol 51
options.C: IP protocol 43
options.D: IP protocol 50

questions.explanation_es: GRE se identifica en la cabecera IP con el número de protocolo 47, distinto de ESP, que usa 50, o AH, que usa 51.

questions.name: GRE / IPsec / AH
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the core protocols that make up the IPsec suite?

options.A: Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP)
options.B: Extensible Authentication Protocol (EAP)
options.C: Internet Key Exchange (IKE)
options.D: Authentication Header (AH)

questions.explanation_es: AH, ESP e IKE son los tres protocolos principales que conforman IPsec; EAP es un marco de autenticación usado en otros contextos, como 802.1X, y no un protocolo central de IPsec.

questions.name: LISP
questions.question: LISP's core design principle splits an endpoint's IP addressing into which two distinct namespaces?

options.A: LISP site identifiers
options.B: Endpoint identifiers (EIDs)
options.C: Routing locators (RLOCs)
options.D: Subnet and host portions

questions.explanation_es: LISP separa la identidad del dispositivo, EID, de su ubicación en la red, RLOC, en lugar de usar una única dirección IP para ambos propósitos.

questions.name: LISP
questions.question: What destination UDP port does the LISP data plane use for encapsulated traffic?

options.A: UDP 4342
options.B: UDP 4341
options.C: UDP 4143
options.D: UDP 4142

questions.explanation_es: El plano de datos de LISP encapsula el tráfico hacia el puerto UDP 4341, mientras que el plano de control, los mensajes de mapeo, usa el puerto UDP 4342.

questions.name: LISP
questions.question: True or false: an ETR is the only type of device that can ever be involved in responding to a map request originated by an ITR.

options.A: True, only the authoritative ETR ever replies
options.B: False, only the Map Resolver itself replies directly with the mapping
options.C: True, because Map Servers never communicate with ITRs
options.D: False, other elements such as a Map Resolver forwarding to an ETR or a Proxy ETR can be involved in the reply path

questions.explanation_es: Aunque el ETR autoritativo suele responder, un Map Resolver puede reenviar la solicitud y un Proxy ETR puede responder en nombre de sitios no LISP, por lo que el ETR no es el único elemento involucrado en la respuesta.

questions.name: LISP
questions.question: In Cisco's SD-Access fabric architecture, which technology serves as the control plane for tracking endpoint location?

options.A: VXLAN
options.B: LISP
options.C: Multiprotocol BGP
options.D: EIGRP

questions.explanation_es: SD-Access usa LISP como plano de control para registrar y resolver la ubicación, RLOC, de cada endpoint, EID, dentro del fabric.

questions.name: VXLAN EVPN/BUM
questions.question: Which UDP port has IANA officially assigned for VXLAN traffic?

options.A: UDP 8472
options.B: UDP 8947
options.C: UDP 4789
options.D: UDP 4987

questions.explanation_es: IANA asignó oficialmente el puerto UDP 4789 para VXLAN; el puerto 8472 fue el usado inicialmente por la implementacion de Linux antes de esa asignacion oficial.

questions.name: VXLAN EVPN/BUM
questions.question: True or false: the original VXLAN specification defines both a standardized data plane and a standardized control plane.

options.A: False, the original specification defines only the data-plane encapsulation, leaving the control plane open
options.B: False, VXLAN defines only a control plane and relies on other protocols for data encapsulation
options.C: True, VXLAN mandates a specific control plane protocol
options.D: True, but only for multicast-based deployments

questions.explanation_es: La especificación original de VXLAN, RFC 7348, solo define la encapsulación del plano de datos; el plano de control, por ejemplo inundación con multicast o EVPN, no forma parte obligatoria de esa especificación.

questions.name: VXLAN EVPN/BUM
questions.question: What is the name of the identifier that uniquely designates a virtual Layer 2 segment within a VXLAN overlay?

options.A: Endpoint identifier (EID)
options.B: VXLAN Network Identifier (VNI)
options.C: VTEP address
options.D: VLAN tag

questions.explanation_es: El VNI, VXLAN Network Identifier, es el identificador de 24 bits que distingue cada segmento de red virtual dentro del overlay VXLAN.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT generally considered a benefit of the hierarchical (multi-layer) LAN design model?

options.A: It speeds up problem isolation during outages
options.B: It simplifies troubleshooting by isolating faults to a specific layer
options.C: It is the design of choice for modern data center fabrics
options.D: It scales more easily as the campus grows

questions.explanation_es: El modelo jerárquico de LAN (acceso-distribución-núcleo) fue diseñado para redes de campus, no para centros de datos modernos, que suelen usar arquitecturas leaf-spine u otras fabrics específicas. Las demás opciones sí son beneficios reconocidos del diseño jerárquico.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: In hierarchical campus design terminology, the access layer is also commonly referred to as the ____.

options.A: policy boundary layer
options.B: end-user layer
options.C: aggregation layer
options.D: network edge

questions.explanation_es: La capa de acceso es donde los endpoints se conectan a la red, por lo que también se le conoce como el borde de la red (network edge). La agregación corresponde a la capa de distribución, no a la de acceso.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: In a hierarchical LAN design building block, how many distribution switches are typically deployed for redundancy?

options.A: Four
options.B: There is no practical limit
options.C: Six
options.D: Two

questions.explanation_es: El bloque de diseño jerárquico normalmente despliega un par de switches de distribución interconectados entre sí, lo que brinda redundancia sin agregar complejidad innecesaria.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which enterprise campus architecture is also commonly known as the collapsed-core design?

options.A: Leaf-spine design
options.B: Two-tier design
options.C: SD-Access fabric design
options.D: Three-tier design

questions.explanation_es: En el diseño de dos capas (two-tier), las funciones del núcleo y la distribución se combinan en un solo par de switches, por lo que se le llama diseño de núcleo colapsado (collapsed-core).

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which two network blocks are typically used to provide end users with access to public cloud providers? (Choose two.)

options.A: Network services block
options.B: WAN edge block
options.C: Data center block
options.D: Internet edge block

questions.explanation_es: El acceso a proveedores de nube pública para los usuarios finales normalmente se realiza a través del bloque de borde de WAN (para conectividad directa vía MPLS/Internet dedicado) y el bloque de borde de Internet (para tráfico hacia Internet y SaaS).

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a recommended technique for building a simplified (collapsed) two-tier campus design?

options.A: Virtual Switching System (VSS)
options.B: Switch stacking
options.C: Daisy-chaining access switches to each other
options.D: StackWise Virtual (SWV)

questions.explanation_es: Las tecnologías de clustering virtual como VSS, StackWise Virtual y el apilamiento de switches simplifican el diseño de campus al presentar varios chasis como un solo switch lógico. Encadenar switches de acceso entre sí (daisy-chaining) no es una práctica recomendada, ya que introduce puntos de falla y complica la topología.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which layer of the hierarchical LAN design model defines the Layer 3 summarization boundary for routing protocols and acts as the network's policy enforcement boundary?

options.A: WAN edge layer
options.B: Distribution layer
options.C: Access layer
options.D: Core layer

questions.explanation_es: La capa de distribución agrega los switches de acceso, resume las rutas hacia el núcleo y funciona como el límite lógico donde se aplican políticas de control (ACLs, QoS, filtrado de rutas).

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: What is the primary motivation for choosing a two-tier (collapsed-core) design over a three-tier design?

options.A: It provides greater overall scalability than a three-tier design
options.B: It is mandatory for deploying first-hop redundancy protocols
options.C: It reduces cost while retaining most of the benefits of a three-tier design
options.D: It removes the need for any Layer 3 boundary in the campus

questions.explanation_es: El diseño de dos capas fusiona el núcleo y la distribución en un solo par de switches, reduciendo el costo del hardware y la complejidad de cableado, mientras conserva la mayoría de los beneficios del diseño de tres capas para campus más pequeños.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the five essential characteristics of cloud computing as defined by NIST?

options.A: On-demand self-service
options.B: Rapid elasticity
options.C: Customer-provided software licensing
options.D: Measured service

questions.explanation_es: El NIST define cinco características esenciales de la nube: autoservicio bajo demanda, acceso amplio a la red, agrupación de recursos (resource pooling), elasticidad rápida y servicio medido. El licenciamiento provisto por el cliente no forma parte de esa definición.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which NIST essential characteristic of cloud computing refers to the provider's ability to monitor, control, and report resource consumption on a per-consumer basis?

options.A: Rapid elasticity
options.B: Broad network access
options.C: Measured service
options.D: Resource pooling

questions.explanation_es: El servicio medido (measured service) es la característica que permite al proveedor y al consumidor tener visibilidad y transparencia sobre el consumo de almacenamiento, cómputo y ancho de banda, típicamente para fines de facturación.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which three cloud service models are defined by NIST? (Choose three.)

options.A: Platform as a Service (PaaS)
options.B: Backend as a Service (BaaS)
options.C: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
options.D: Software as a Service (SaaS)

questions.explanation_es: El NIST define tres modelos de servicio en la nube: software como servicio (SaaS), infraestructura como servicio (IaaS) y plataforma como servicio (PaaS). Backend as a Service no es uno de los modelos definidos por el NIST.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which cloud service model gives the consumer the ability to provision compute, storage, and network resources while the consumer retains control over the operating systems and applications deployed on top?

options.A: Software as a Service (SaaS)
options.B: Function as a Service (FaaS)
options.C: Platform as a Service (PaaS)
options.D: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)

questions.explanation_es: IaaS entrega al consumidor recursos de cómputo, almacenamiento y red bajo demanda, dejando a su cargo el sistema operativo, las aplicaciones y su mantenimiento, mientras el proveedor gestiona la infraestructura física subyacente.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which cloud service model allows consumers to build and run applications using the provider's programming languages, libraries, and tools, without having to manage the underlying compute, network, or storage?

options.A: Software as a Service (SaaS)
options.B: Colocation services
options.C: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
options.D: Platform as a Service (PaaS)

questions.explanation_es: PaaS ofrece un entorno de desarrollo con lenguajes de programación, bibliotecas, servicios y herramientas, mientras el proveedor de la nube mantiene el control de la infraestructura subyacente (cómputo, red y almacenamiento).

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which three of the following are cloud deployment models, as opposed to cloud service models? (Choose three.)

options.A: Private cloud
options.B: Public cloud
options.C: Hybrid cloud
options.D: Software as a Service (SaaS)

questions.explanation_es: Los modelos de despliegue de la nube (private, public, hybrid y community) describen dónde y por quién se opera la infraestructura, mientras que SaaS es un modelo de servicio, no de despliegue.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which cloud deployment model is characterized by dedicating the infrastructure to a single organization, giving that organization a greater sense of control and security?

options.A: Public cloud
options.B: Hybrid cloud
options.C: Private cloud
options.D: Community cloud

questions.explanation_es: En una nube privada, la infraestructura se destina exclusivamente a una sola organización, lo que le otorga mayor sensación de control y seguridad, ya sea que se aloje internamente o la administre un tercero.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which cloud deployment model is provisioned for a specific group of organizations that share common concerns, such as compliance, security requirements, or mission, without being dedicated to a single tenant?

options.A: Public cloud
options.B: Community cloud
options.C: Hybrid cloud
options.D: Private cloud

questions.explanation_es: La nube comunitaria (community cloud) está destinada a un grupo específico de organizaciones con intereses o requisitos compartidos, ofreciendo beneficios de seguridad similares a una nube privada junto con el modelo de costos compartidos de una nube pública.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Compared to a fully on-premises deployment, which of the following is a key advantage typically associated with cloud infrastructure?

options.A: It automatically guarantees compliance with all regulatory requirements
options.B: It eliminates the need for any network connectivity to reach applications
options.C: It offers a pay-as-you-go billing model that avoids large upfront capital expenses
options.D: It removes any dependency on the cloud provider's own infrastructure

questions.explanation_es: Uno de los principales atractivos de la nube es el modelo de pago por uso (pay-as-you-go), que convierte el gasto de capital (CapEx) en gasto operativo (OpEx) y evita grandes inversiones iniciales en infraestructura on-premises.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which cloud service model gives a consumer the ability to use applications that run entirely on the provider's infrastructure, without managing servers, storage, or the underlying platform?

options.A: Software as a Service (SaaS)
options.B: Backend as a Service (BaaS)
options.C: Platform as a Service (PaaS)
options.D: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)

questions.explanation_es: SaaS entrega aplicaciones completas alojadas y administradas por el proveedor de la nube; el consumidor solo utiliza la aplicación, sin gestionar servidores, almacenamiento, ni la plataforma subyacente.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which three characteristics does NIST associate with cloud services? (Choose three.)

options.A: Resource reservation
options.B: On-demand self-service
options.C: Resource pooling
options.D: Broad network access

questions.explanation_es: El autoservicio bajo demanda, el acceso amplio a la red y la agrupación de recursos (resource pooling) son características esenciales del NIST. La 'reservación de recursos' no forma parte de esa definición; en la nube los recursos se asignan dinámicamente, no se reservan de forma fija.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which type of private cloud deployment can be hosted off-premises by a third-party provider rather than inside the organization's own data center?

options.A: Hybrid cloud
options.B: Community cloud
options.C: Hosted private cloud
options.D: Internal private cloud

questions.explanation_es: La nube privada alojada (hosted private cloud) es operada por un tercero fuera de las instalaciones de la organización, a diferencia de la nube privada interna, que se ubica dentro del propio centro de datos de la empresa.

questions.name: Diseños de red (2-tier/3-tier/fabric/cloud)
questions.question: Which of the following is a common consideration in favor of keeping an infrastructure on-premises rather than moving it to the cloud?

options.A: Faster time to market for new applications
options.B: Support for a pay-as-you-go consumption model
options.C: Regulatory requirements that mandate hosting data on-premises
options.D: A sense of near-unlimited scaling capacity

questions.explanation_es: Algunas organizaciones operan en entornos altamente regulados que exigen que ciertas aplicaciones y datos permanezcan alojados en sus propias instalaciones, lo cual es una consideración clave a favor de mantener la infraestructura on-premises.

questions.name: Alta disponibilidad (SSO/FHRP)
questions.question: Which statement correctly describes the relationship between Stateful Switchover (SSO) and Nonstop Forwarding (NSF) on a Cisco device?

options.A: SSO requires NSF to be enabled before it can synchronize state
options.B: SSO and NSF are unrelated features that cannot be used together
options.C: NSF can operate fully independently, with no dependency on SSO
options.D: NSF requires SSO to be enabled and operational first

questions.explanation_es: NSF depende de que SSO esté habilitado, ya que SSO sincroniza el estado entre el supervisor activo y el standby, y NSF utiliza esa sincronización para seguir reenviando paquetes durante la conmutación del plano de control.

questions.name: Alta disponibilidad (SSO/FHRP)
questions.question: Which high-availability mechanism requires that neighboring routers support specific routing protocol extensions in order to preserve routes during a control-plane restart?

options.A: Nonstop Routing (NSR)
options.B: Graceful Restart (GR)
options.C: Route Processor Redundancy (RPR)
options.D: Stateful Switchover with Nonstop Forwarding (SSO/NSF)

questions.explanation_es: Graceful Restart se basa en extensiones específicas de cada protocolo de enrutamiento (por ejemplo, la capacidad de Graceful Restart en BGP o el Grace-LSA en OSPF) que deben ser soportadas por los routers vecinos para mantener las rutas mientras el router se reinicia.

questions.name: Alta disponibilidad (SSO/FHRP)
questions.question: In HSRP, when two routers are configured with the same priority value, which factor breaks the tie to determine which router becomes active?

options.A: The router with the lowest interface IP address
options.B: The router with the higher IP address configured on the HSRP interface
options.C: The router that has been up the longest
options.D: The router with the lowest configured hello timer

questions.explanation_es: Cuando dos routers HSRP tienen la misma prioridad, el desempate se resuelve comparando las direcciones IP primarias configuradas en la interfaz; el router con la dirección IP más alta se convierte en el activo.

questions.name: Alta disponibilidad (SSO/FHRP)
questions.question: Which hardware redundancy mechanism allows a standby supervisor engine to immediately take over Layer 2 and Layer 3 forwarding state if the active supervisor engine fails?

options.A: Stateful Switchover (SSO)
options.B: Gateway Load Balancing Protocol (GLBP)
options.C: Nonstop Forwarding (NSF)
options.D: Virtual Switching System (VSS)

questions.explanation_es: SSO sincroniza continuamente el estado del plano de control y de reenvío entre el supervisor activo y el standby, permitiendo que el standby tome el control de inmediato ante una falla, sin necesidad de reiniciar el chasis.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the mandatory components of the Cisco SD-WAN architecture?

options.A: vBond orchestrator
options.B: vAnalytics
options.C: vSmart controller
options.D: vManage NMS

questions.explanation_es: Los componentes obligatorios de la solución SD-WAN de Cisco son el controlador vSmart (plano de control), los routers WAN edge (plano de datos), el orquestador vBond (plano de orquestación) y vManage (plano de gestión). vAnalytics es un componente opcional de análisis, no obligatorio.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: What type of permanent secure connection does a vSmart controller establish with each SD-WAN router (WAN edge) in the fabric?

options.A: A GRE tunnel protected by IPsec
options.B: A DTLS (or TLS) tunnel
options.C: An IPsec tunnel
options.D: A plain SSH session

questions.explanation_es: El controlador vSmart establece un túnel permanente DTLS (o TLS) con cada router WAN edge autenticado, y sobre ese túnel se establece la vecindad OMP para distribuir rutas y políticas.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: Which Cisco SD-WAN component serves as the single pane of glass for centralized configuration, monitoring, and management of the fabric?

options.A: vBond orchestrator
options.B: vManage
options.C: vSmart controller
options.D: Cisco DNA Center

questions.explanation_es: vManage es el componente del plano de gestión que ofrece una única interfaz centralizada (single pane of glass) para configurar, monitorear y solucionar problemas en toda la fabric de SD-WAN.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: What is the main function of the vBond orchestrator in the Cisco SD-WAN architecture?

options.A: To authenticate the vManage NMS and the SD-WAN routers and orchestrate connectivity between them
options.B: To advertise OMP routes between SD-WAN routers directly, bypassing vSmart
options.C: To authenticate the vSmart controllers and the vManage NMS and orchestrate connectivity between them
options.D: To authenticate the vSmart controllers and the SD-WAN routers and orchestrate connectivity between them

questions.explanation_es: El orquestador vBond autentica tanto a los controladores vSmart como a los routers SD-WAN cuando se incorporan a la fabric, y orquesta el establecimiento de la conectividad inicial entre ellos, actuando como punto de entrada al overlay.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: Which two router platform options can serve as WAN edge routers in a Cisco SD-WAN fabric? (Choose two.)

options.A: vEdge routers
options.B: Standalone ASR 1000 routers running only classic IOS XE
options.C: vBond routers
options.D: cEdge routers (IOS XE SD-WAN)

questions.explanation_es: Los routers WAN edge de Cisco SD-WAN pueden ser dispositivos vEdge (basados en el sistema operativo Viptela) o dispositivos cEdge, que ejecutan la funcionalidad SD-WAN sobre Cisco IOS XE.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: In a Cisco SD-WAN solution, which plane of operation is responsible for the automatic onboarding of new SD-WAN routers into the fabric?

options.A: Control plane
options.B: Management plane
options.C: Data plane
options.D: Orchestration plane

questions.explanation_es: El plano de orquestación, implementado por el vBond orchestrator, se encarga de la incorporación automática (zero-touch) de los routers SD-WAN a la fabric, autenticándolos y dirigiéndolos hacia los controladores correspondientes.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: Which statement about WAN edge router deployment options in Cisco SD-WAN is correct?

options.A: WAN edge routers can only be deployed as dedicated physical appliances
options.B: WAN edge routers can be deployed as physical appliances or as virtual/software-based routers in a private or public cloud
options.C: Only the vSmart controller can be virtualized; WAN edge routers cannot
options.D: WAN edge routers require specialized ASICs that are not available in any virtualized form

questions.explanation_es: Los routers WAN edge de Cisco SD-WAN están disponibles tanto como appliances físicos como en forma virtual (por ejemplo, sobre VMware ESXi, KVM, AWS o Azure), lo que brinda flexibilidad de despliegue en sitios físicos o en la nube.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: Which Cisco SD-WAN component provides the single pane of glass for the solution?

options.A: Cisco ISE
options.B: vManage
options.C: Cisco DNA Center
options.D: vSmart controller

questions.explanation_es: vManage centraliza la configuración, la contabilidad, el desempeño y la gestión de seguridad de toda la solución SD-WAN en una sola consola, funcionando como el panel único de administración.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: In an SD-WAN solution, which plane of operation is responsible for the central configuration and monitoring of the entire deployment?

options.A: Control plane
options.B: Orchestration plane
options.C: Management plane
options.D: Data plane

questions.explanation_es: El plano de gestión, representado por vManage, es responsable de la configuración centralizada, el monitoreo y la administración general del despliegue SD-WAN.

questions.name: SD-WAN componentes
questions.question: Which SD-WAN component behaves similarly to a BGP route reflector, receiving routes from WAN edge routers, applying policy, and re-advertising them to other WAN edge routers?

options.A: vManage
options.B: vBond orchestrator
options.C: vSmart controller
options.D: WAN edge router

questions.explanation_es: El controlador vSmart recibe las rutas OMP de los routers WAN edge, les aplica las políticas centralizadas y luego las redistribuye a los demás routers del fabric, de forma análoga a como un route reflector de BGP redistribuye rutas entre sus clientes.

questions.name: SD-WAN beneficios/limitaciones
questions.question: Which statement best describes Cisco SD-WAN's independence from the underlying transport network?

options.A: SD-WAN builds a secure overlay over any transport, including MPLS, Internet, and cellular (4G/5G) circuits
options.B: SD-WAN can only operate over MPLS circuits to guarantee end-to-end QoS
options.C: SD-WAN can only operate over public Internet connections
options.D: SD-WAN requires a dedicated leased-line transport to function

questions.explanation_es: Una de las principales ventajas de SD-WAN es su independencia del transporte: construye un overlay seguro sobre cualquier tipo de underlay, ya sea MPLS, Internet, Metro Ethernet o enlaces celulares, sin depender de un único tipo de circuito.

questions.name: SD-WAN beneficios/limitaciones
questions.question: Which Cisco SD-WAN feature automates connectivity to workloads running in a public cloud (IaaS) when accessed from a data center or branch site?

options.A: Secure Direct Internet Access (DIA)
options.B: Cloud OnRamp for Colocation
options.C: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS
options.D: Cloud OnRamp for IaaS

questions.explanation_es: Cloud OnRamp for IaaS automatiza la conectividad hacia cargas de trabajo alojadas en proveedores de nube pública (IaaS) como AWS o Azure, desplegando y conectando routers virtuales SD-WAN dentro de esas nubes.

questions.name: SD-WAN beneficios/limitaciones
questions.question: Which Cisco SD-WAN feature allows an administrator to choose the specific network path that traffic for a given SaaS application takes across the fabric?

options.A: Cloud OnRamp for Colocation
options.B: Cloud OnRamp for IaaS
options.C: Cloud OnRamp for PaaS
options.D: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS

questions.explanation_es: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS monitorea el desempeño de los distintos caminos disponibles hacia una aplicación SaaS y permite elegir dinámicamente la mejor ruta para el tráfico de esa aplicación específica.

questions.name: SD-WAN beneficios/limitaciones
questions.question: Which Cisco SD-WAN feature automatically deploys WAN edge router instances in a public cloud so they become part of the SD-WAN overlay?

options.A: Cloud OnRamp for Colocation
options.B: Cloud OnRamp for PaaS
options.C: Cloud OnRamp for IaaS
options.D: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS

questions.explanation_es: Cloud OnRamp for IaaS despliega automáticamente instancias virtuales de routers WAN edge dentro del proveedor de nube pública, integrándolas al overlay de SD-WAN sin intervención manual extensa.

questions.name: SD-Access control/data plane
questions.question: Why did Cisco choose VXLAN, rather than native LISP encapsulation, for the SD-Access data plane?

options.A: VXLAN eliminates the need for any control plane in the fabric
options.B: VXLAN can encapsulate Layer 2 frames, which native LISP encapsulation cannot
options.C: VXLAN provides built-in IPv6 support that native LISP encapsulation lacks
options.D: VXLAN uses a smaller header than LISP, reducing per-packet overhead

questions.explanation_es: VXLAN permite encapsular tramas de Capa 2 sobre una red de Capa 3, lo cual es necesario para el overlay de SD-Access, mientras que la encapsulación nativa de LISP no soporta el transporte de tramas Ethernet completas.

questions.name: SD-Access control/data plane
questions.question: How does the VXLAN header used by SD-Access differ from the standard VXLAN header defined in RFC 7348?

options.A: It is a completely proprietary header unrelated to RFC 7348
options.B: It repurposes reserved header fields to carry a Group Policy ID used for scalable group tags
options.C: It doubles the header length to carry native IPv6 addressing
options.D: It removes the VNI field and replaces it with a LISP instance ID

questions.explanation_es: SD-Access modifica el encabezado VXLAN estándar aprovechando campos reservados para transportar un Group Policy ID, lo que permite propagar las etiquetas de grupo escalable (SGT) junto con el tráfico encapsulado.

questions.name: SD-Access control/data plane
questions.question: Which protocol serves as the control plane for the Cisco SD-Access fabric?

options.A: PIM multicast
options.B: EVPN MP-BGP
options.C: Locator/ID Separation Protocol (LISP)
options.D: The VXLAN control plane defined in RFC 7348

questions.explanation_es: El plano de control de SD-Access se basa en LISP, que separa la identidad del endpoint (EID) de su ubicación en la red (RLOC) mediante un sistema de mapeo centralizado.

questions.name: SD-Access control/data plane
questions.question: Which field was added to the VXLAN header used by SD-Access to allow it to carry scalable group tags (SGT)?

options.A: Group Policy ID
options.B: LISP Instance ID field
options.C: VXLAN Network Identifier extension
options.D: TrustSec Session field

questions.explanation_es: El campo Group Policy ID, agregado al encabezado VXLAN mediante el uso de bits reservados, es el que permite transportar la etiqueta de grupo escalable (SGT) para aplicar políticas de TrustSec en el fabric.

questions.name: SD-Access control/data plane
questions.question: Which types of network environments was Cisco SD-Access primarily designed for?

options.A: Service provider WAN environments
options.B: Enterprise campus and branch environments
options.C: Data center environments
options.D: Public cloud provider backbones

questions.explanation_es: SD-Access fue diseñado específicamente para entornos de campus empresarial y sucursales, y no para centros de datos, proveedores de servicio ni redes WAN, que utilizan otras soluciones de fabric.

questions.name: SD-Access control/data plane
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT considered a core physical or controller component of the Cisco SD-Access fabric architecture?

options.A: Cisco DNA Center
options.B: A dedicated next-generation firewall appliance
options.C: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE)
options.D: Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs)

questions.explanation_es: Los componentes del fabric de SD-Access incluyen switches, routers, WLCs, access points y las appliances controladoras Cisco DNA Center e ISE. Un firewall dedicado no es un componente central de la arquitectura del fabric.

questions.name: SD-Access control/data plane
questions.question: In SD-Access terminology, what is the name given to the physical network of devices responsible for transporting packets between fabric nodes, independent of any overlay functionality?

options.A: Overlay network
options.B: Fusion network
options.C: Underlay network
options.D: Transit network

questions.explanation_es: El underlay es la red física subyacente cuya única función es transportar paquetes entre los dispositivos del fabric, sirviendo de base para que el overlay de SD-Access opere sobre ella.

questions.name: SD-Access control/data plane
questions.question: Which SD-Access architecture component forms part of the Layer 3 network that interconnects border nodes and edge nodes, without itself performing fabric overlay encapsulation?

options.A: Fusion router
options.B: Extended node
options.C: Control-plane node
options.D: Intermediate node

questions.explanation_es: Los nodos intermedios forman parte de la red de Capa 3 del underlay que interconecta a los nodos borde (border) y los nodos edge del fabric, encargándose únicamente del reenvío IP y no de las funciones de encapsulación del overlay.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: By default, what is the maximum number of hops the traceroute command will attempt before giving up on reaching the destination?
questions.explanation_es: Por defecto, el comando traceroute en Cisco IOS intenta hasta 30 saltos (TTL máximo) antes de detenerse si no alcanza el destino; 20 saltos es un valor incorrecto que suele usarse como distractor.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: When troubleshooting OSPF adjacency problems, debugging output is especially useful for identifying which three of the following issues? (Choose three.)

options.A: Mismatched MTU settings between neighbors
options.B: BGP route redistribution filters
options.C: Contents of the IP routing table
options.D: Mismatched hello/dead timer values
options.E: Mismatched subnet masks on the shared link

questions.explanation_es: El debug de adyacencias OSPF (por ejemplo, debug ip ospf adj) es útil para detectar discordancias de MTU, de temporizadores hello/dead y de máscara de subred entre vecinos, ya que estas causan que la adyacencia no se forme o se quede en un estado como ExStart. Ver la tabla de enrutamiento se hace con show ip route, y la redistribución de BGP no está relacionada con la formación de adyacencias OSPF.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which debugging capability lets you restrict debug output to specific conditions, such as a particular interface or IP address, instead of flooding the console with every event of that type?

options.A: Extended ping
options.B: Conditional debugging
options.C: SNMP polling
options.D: Flexible NetFlow sampling

questions.explanation_es: La depuración condicional (conditional debugging) permite habilitar debugs de forma selectiva según una condición, como una interfaz o dirección IP específica, evitando saturar la CPU y la consola con mensajes de todos los eventos de ese tipo.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which command is used to discover the sequence of Layer 3 hops that packets take toward a destination?

options.A: traceroute
options.B: show ip route
options.C: show cdp neighbors
options.D: ping
