questions.explanation_es: El comando traceroute envía paquetes con valores de TTL crecientes para descubrir, salto a salto, la ruta que siguen los paquetes hacia un destino determinado.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: In an extended ping, which option helps identify the smallest MTU supported along the path to a destination?

options.A: Setting a data pattern of 0xABCD
options.B: Setting the Don't Fragment (DF) bit with an increasing packet size
options.C: Increasing the repeat count
options.D: Enabling the Record route option

questions.explanation_es: Al establecer el bit de No Fragmentar (DF) y aumentar progresivamente el tamaño del paquete en un ping extendido, un salto con una MTU menor descartará el paquete y devolverá un mensaje ICMP de fragmentación necesaria, lo que permite identificar la MTU más pequeña en la ruta.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: In the SNMP framework, which component is responsible for controlling and monitoring the managed network hosts, typically by polling agents or receiving trap messages?

options.A: SNMP manager
options.B: SNMP responder
options.C: SNMP agent
options.D: SNMP MIB

questions.explanation_es: El gestor SNMP (SNMP manager), habitualmente un sistema de gestión de red (NMS), es el que controla y monitoriza la actividad de los hosts de red, recolectando datos mediante sondeo (polling) de los agentes o recibiendo mensajes trap de estos.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which command disables every active debug output on a router in one step?

options.A: no debug ip packet
options.B: undebug all
options.C: clear debug all
options.D: debug all disable

questions.explanation_es: El comando undebug all (equivalente a no debug all) desactiva de una sola vez todos los debugs que estén activos en el router.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: In traceroute output, which single letter indicates that a probe was dropped because it was administratively filtered, such as by an access list?

options.A: N
options.B: A
options.C: U
options.D: Q

questions.explanation_es: La letra A en la salida de traceroute indica que el paquete fue administrativamente prohibido, es decir, filtrado por una lista de control de acceso (ACL) en algún salto del camino.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Why should round-trip times from ping or traceroute be interpreted cautiously when the destination is the router itself?

options.A: ICMP is disabled by default on router interfaces
options.B: The packet destined to the router is process-switched rather than hardware/CEF-switched
options.C: Ping cannot target a router's own interface address
options.D: Traceroute always rounds RTT values up to the nearest millisecond

questions.explanation_es: Cuando el destino es el propio router, el paquete se conmuta por proceso (process-switched) en lugar de usar CEF o conmutación por hardware, lo que añade una latencia adicional que no representa fielmente el rendimiento real del enlace.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: What is the default and maximum TTL value used by the traceroute command in Cisco IOS?
questions.explanation_es: El valor de TTL máximo (y por defecto) para el comando traceroute en Cisco IOS es 30 saltos.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which statement best describes an SNMP trap?

options.A: An unsolicited notification an agent sends to the manager when a defined event occurs
options.B: A scheduled bulk transfer of every MIB variable on the agent
options.C: A request the manager repeats until the agent acknowledges receipt
options.D: A message the manager sends to request a specific MIB object from the agent

questions.explanation_es: Un trap SNMP es una notificación no solicitada que el agente envía al gestor cuando ocurre un evento o condición definida, proporcionando una alerta casi en tiempo real sin esperar a ser consultado.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Why are SNMP informs generally considered more reliable than SNMP traps?

options.A: Informs are encrypted by default while traps are not
options.B: Informs can only be sent between devices running SNMPv3
options.C: Informs use TCP while traps use UDP
options.D: Informs are retransmitted until the manager acknowledges receipt, whereas traps are not

questions.explanation_es: A diferencia de los traps, los mensajes inform se reenvían repetidamente hasta que el gestor SNMP confirma su recepción, lo que los hace más fiables ante la pérdida de paquetes.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which two statements accurately describe the role of the SNMP agent? (Choose two.)

options.A: It requires SNMPv3 informs in order to operate at all
options.B: It resides on the managed device and maintains the local MIB data reported to the manager
options.C: It decides the polling interval used across the entire management domain
options.D: It can generate unsolicited trap messages toward the SNMP manager

questions.explanation_es: El agente SNMP reside en el dispositivo gestionado, mantiene los datos locales de la MIB y responde a las solicitudes Get/Set del gestor; además, puede generar mensajes trap no solicitados hacia el gestor cuando ocurre un evento relevante.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which two actions help minimize the performance impact of running debug ip packet on a production router? (Choose two.)

options.A: Buffer the debug output and review it afterward with the logging buffer instead of sending it to the console
options.B: Apply an access list so only the traffic of interest is captured
options.C: Increase the console baud rate before enabling the debug
options.D: Run the debug command only from user EXEC mode

questions.explanation_es: Para reducir el impacto de debug ip packet se recomienda usar una ACL que limite el tráfico capturado a lo estrictamente necesario y almacenar la salida en el buffer de logging para revisarla después, en lugar de enviarla directamente a la consola, que consume más recursos.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: In traceroute output, which letter indicates that an intermediate router reported the destination network as unreachable?

options.A: Q
options.B: U
options.C: H
options.D: N

questions.explanation_es: La letra N en la salida de traceroute significa que la red de destino es inalcanzable (network unreachable), reportado por algún salto en el camino.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT something the ping command can determine about a remote host?

options.A: The specific Layer 3 path taken to reach the host
options.B: Whether any of the probes were lost
options.C: Whether the host is currently reachable
options.D: The measured round-trip delay to the host

questions.explanation_es: El comando ping no puede determinar la ruta que siguen los paquetes hacia el destino; para eso se utiliza traceroute, que muestra salto a salto el camino recorrido.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a valid SNMPv3 security level?

options.A: authNoPriv
options.B: noAuthNoPriv
options.C: authPriv
options.D: privNoAuth

questions.explanation_es: Los niveles de seguridad válidos en SNMPv3 son noAuthNoPriv, authNoPriv y authPriv. privNoAuth no existe como nivel de seguridad, ya que en SNMPv3 no se puede tener privacidad (cifrado) sin autenticación.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which syslog severity level indicates that the system itself has become unusable?

options.A: Emergency (level 0)
options.B: Alert (level 1)
options.C: Critical (level 2)
options.D: Error (level 3)

questions.explanation_es: El nivel de severidad 0 (Emergency) es el más grave e indica que el sistema es inestable o inutilizable.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which syslog severity level represents a normal but significant condition, worth noting but not indicating a problem?

options.A: Notification (level 5)
options.B: Informational (level 6)
options.C: Warning (level 4)
options.D: Error (level 3)

questions.explanation_es: El nivel de severidad 5 (Notification) indica una condición normal pero significativa, que merece atención aunque no represente un problema.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the standard elements that make up a syslog message?

options.A: Severity
options.B: Timestamp
options.C: Notification
options.D: Sequence number

questions.explanation_es: Notification es el nombre de un nivel de severidad, no un elemento del formato del mensaje de syslog; los elementos típicos son el número de secuencia, la marca de tiempo, la facility, la severidad y el mnemónico o descripción.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: Which element of a syslog message identifies the source or cause of the message, such as a hardware component, protocol, or software module?

options.A: Facility
options.B: Sequence number
options.C: Severity
options.D: Timestamp

questions.explanation_es: La facility indica el origen o la causa del mensaje de syslog, que puede ser un componente de hardware, un protocolo o un módulo del software del sistema.

questions.name: Diagnóstico (debug/traceroute/ping/SNMP/syslog)
questions.question: If logging is configured to severity level 2 (Critical), which severity levels will actually be logged? (Choose three.)

options.A: Critical
options.B: Emergency
options.C: Alert
options.D: Notification

questions.explanation_es: Al configurar el nivel de logging en 2 (Critical), IOS registra ese nivel y todos los más graves (numéricamente menores): Emergency (0), Alert (1) y Critical (2). Notification (5) es menos grave y no queda incluido.

questions.name: Flexible NetFlow
questions.question: As of the ENCOR curriculum, what is the most recent version of traditional Cisco NetFlow (prior to Flexible NetFlow and IPFIX)?

options.A: Version 9
options.B: Version 7
options.C: Version 1
options.D: Version 5

questions.explanation_es: La versión más reciente del NetFlow tradicional de Cisco es la versión 9, que introdujo un formato de plantillas flexible que después sirvió de base para IPFIX.

questions.name: Flexible NetFlow
questions.question: Which Cisco flow-monitoring technology allows the administrator to define custom key fields instead of being limited to a fixed set of match fields?

options.A: sFlow
options.B: Flexible NetFlow
options.C: Traditional NetFlow
options.D: IPFIX only

questions.explanation_es: Flexible NetFlow permite definir campos clave (key fields) personalizados para identificar los flujos, a diferencia del NetFlow tradicional, que está limitado a un conjunto fijo de campos.

questions.name: Flexible NetFlow
questions.question: Which three components are used when building a Flexible NetFlow configuration? (Choose three.)

options.A: Flow exporter
options.B: Flow sampler
options.C: Flow record
options.D: Flow monitor

questions.explanation_es: Una configuración típica de Flexible NetFlow se apoya en el flow record (qué campos capturar), el flow monitor (que aplica el record y mantiene la caché de flujos) y el flow exporter (que envía los datos a un colector); el flow sampler es opcional y top talkers es solo un informe, no un componente de configuración.

questions.name: Flexible NetFlow
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the packet attributes traditionally used to define an IP flow in NetFlow?

options.A: Class of service
options.B: Source IP address
options.C: Destination MAC address
options.D: Destination port

questions.explanation_es: NetFlow define un flujo usando atributos de capa 3/4 como direcciones IP de origen y destino, puertos, protocolo, interfaz y CoS; la dirección MAC de destino es un campo de capa 2 que no forma parte de las claves tradicionales de NetFlow.

questions.name: Flexible NetFlow
questions.question: Which Cisco technology can track a wide range of packet fields across Layer 2, IPv4, and IPv6 flows, going beyond what traditional NetFlow supports?

options.A: sFlow
options.B: NetFlow version 9
options.C: NetFlow version 10
options.D: Flexible NetFlow

questions.explanation_es: Flexible NetFlow puede rastrear una amplia variedad de campos en flujos de Capa 2, IPv4 e IPv6, superando las limitaciones del NetFlow tradicional.

questions.name: Flexible NetFlow
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an actual component of a Flexible NetFlow configuration?

options.A: Flow session
options.B: Flow monitor
options.C: Flow record
options.D: Flow exporter

questions.explanation_es: Flow session no es un componente real de Flexible NetFlow; los componentes son flow record, flow monitor, flow exporter y, opcionalmente, flow sampler.

questions.name: Flexible NetFlow
questions.question: Which four elements can be part of a complete Flexible NetFlow configuration? (Choose four.)

options.A: Sequence number
options.B: Flow exporter
options.C: Flow record
options.D: Flow sampler

questions.explanation_es: Flow record, flow monitor, flow exporter y flow sampler son los componentes que se combinan para configurar Flexible NetFlow; el número de secuencia no tiene relación con esta configuración.

questions.name: SPAN/RSPAN/ERSPAN
questions.question: What is the primary purpose of ERSPAN?

options.A: Mirroring traffic from a port to a destination port on a different local switch
options.B: Mirroring traffic from a device and carrying it across a routed Layer 3 network to a remote destination
options.C: Mirroring traffic from a port into a specific local VLAN
options.D: Mirroring traffic between two ports on the same switch

questions.explanation_es: ERSPAN encapsula el tráfico espejado y lo transporta a través de una red enrutada de Capa 3 hasta un destino remoto, a diferencia de SPAN (mismo switch) y RSPAN (VLAN dedicada dentro de la misma red conmutada de Capa 2).

questions.name: SPAN/RSPAN/ERSPAN
questions.question: Which requirement applies specifically to a local SPAN session?

options.A: The destination port must be a Layer 3 routed interface
options.B: The source and destination ports must reside on the same switch
options.C: Traffic must be encapsulated in GRE before reaching the destination port
options.D: Source and destination must be connected through a dedicated VLAN

questions.explanation_es: En una sesión de SPAN local, tanto los puertos origen como el puerto destino deben estar en el mismo switch; para monitorear entre switches distintos se necesitan RSPAN o ERSPAN.

questions.name: SPAN/RSPAN/ERSPAN
questions.question: How does an ERSPAN source session deliver mirrored traffic to the ERSPAN destination session?

options.A: By flooding it out every trunk port in the source VLAN
options.B: By encapsulating it in a routable GRE tunnel sent across the IP network
options.C: By copying it into a reserved 802.1Q VLAN tag
options.D: By forwarding it unmodified over a crossover cable

questions.explanation_es: ERSPAN encapsula el tráfico capturado en paquetes GRE enrutables, lo que permite enviarlo a través de una red IP hacia la sesión de destino ERSPAN, sin necesidad de conectividad Capa 2 directa.

questions.name: SPAN/RSPAN/ERSPAN
questions.question: What advantage does ERSPAN offer compared to a basic local SPAN session?

options.A: It eliminates the need for a destination analyzer altogether
options.B: It requires no configuration on the source switch
options.C: It can monitor traffic from multiple ports or VLANs and deliver it to one or more destinations across a routed network
options.D: It only works with EtherChannel source interfaces

questions.explanation_es: ERSPAN aporta la flexibilidad de monitorizar tráfico de uno o varios puertos o VLANs y entregarlo a uno o más destinos, incluso a través de una red enrutada, algo que el SPAN local no permite.

questions.name: SPAN/RSPAN/ERSPAN
questions.question: Which SPAN implementation requires dedicating a special VLAN to carry the mirrored traffic between switches?

options.A: Local SPAN
options.B: ERSPAN
options.C: RSPAN
options.D: VSPAN

questions.explanation_es: RSPAN transporta el tráfico espejado como tráfico de Capa 2 no enrutable sobre una VLAN dedicada y específica para esa sesión, propagada por todos los switches participantes.

questions.name: SPAN/RSPAN/ERSPAN
questions.question: Which command displays the session type, the source ports for each monitored direction, and the destination port of a SPAN/RSPAN session?

options.A: show monitor
options.B: show span status
options.C: show logging
options.D: show flow monitor

questions.explanation_es: El comando show monitor muestra el tipo de sesión (local, RSPAN, ERSPAN), los puertos origen y la dirección monitoreada, así como el puerto o sesión destino.

questions.name: IP SLA
questions.question: Which four metrics can IP SLA be configured to monitor? (Choose four.)

options.A: Packet loss
options.B: Jitter
options.C: Syslog message severity
options.D: SNMP trap contents

questions.explanation_es: IP SLA puede medir retardo (delay), jitter, pérdida de paquetes y puntuaciones de calidad de voz (por ejemplo, MOS), entre otras métricas de rendimiento; no está diseñado para monitorear mensajes de syslog ni el contenido de traps SNMP.

questions.name: IP SLA
questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the ICMP echo operation in IP SLA?

options.A: To synchronize the clock between the source and the responder
options.B: To measure end-to-end response time and verify basic IP connectivity to a target
options.C: To negotiate which flow exporter format will be used
options.D: To distribute routing updates between IP SLA-enabled routers

questions.explanation_es: La operación ICMP echo de IP SLA envía sondas para medir el tiempo de respuesta extremo a extremo hacia un dispositivo y también permite verificar la conectividad IP básica hacia ese destino.

questions.name: IP SLA
questions.question: Is an IP SLA responder mandatory for IP SLA operations to function?

options.A: False, a responder is only used to enable SNMP traps
options.B: True, but only for UDP-based operations
options.C: True, without a responder no IP SLA operation can run
options.D: False, IP SLA can run without a responder, though the responder improves measurement accuracy

questions.explanation_es: El responder de IP SLA no es obligatorio para que las operaciones funcionen, pero cuando está habilitado en el dispositivo destino permite obtener mediciones más precisas, como la marca de tiempo de llegada, sin necesitar sondas dedicadas adicionales.

questions.name: IP SLA
questions.question: Can multiple IP SLA operations, each performing a different measurement or test, be configured simultaneously on the same device?

options.A: Yes, a single device can run multiple independent IP SLA instances at once
options.B: Yes, but only if all operations use the same protocol
options.C: No, multiple operations require a dedicated IP SLA responder appliance
options.D: No, a device can run only one IP SLA operation at a time

questions.explanation_es: Un mismo dispositivo puede tener configuradas múltiples instancias de IP SLA simultáneamente, cada una realizando una operación o verificación diferente, identificadas por su propio número de operación.

questions.name: IP SLA
questions.question: Which three of the following can be verified or measured using IP SLA? (Choose three.)

options.A: Packet loss
options.B: One-way or round-trip delay
options.C: Syslog message delivery
options.D: Website or server response time and availability

questions.explanation_es: IP SLA puede reportar pérdida de paquetes, tiempo de respuesta y disponibilidad de servidores o sitios web, y retardo; no tiene relación con la entrega de mensajes de syslog.

questions.name: Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which three of the following are top-level sections of the Cisco DNA/Catalyst Center dashboard? (Choose three.)

options.A: Assurance
options.B: Operate
options.C: Plan
options.D: Design

questions.explanation_es: Assurance, Design y Provision son secciones reales del panel de Cisco DNA Center (junto con Policy, que no aparece entre estas opciones); Plan y Operate no son secciones propias de la plataforma.

questions.name: Catalyst Center
questions.question: True or false: Cisco DNA/Catalyst Center Assurance can monitor only routers and switches.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: Cisco DNA Center Assurance también monitoriza controladores inalámbricos, puntos de acceso y dispositivos cliente, no solo routers y switches.

questions.name: Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which two capabilities help Cisco DNA/Catalyst Center Assurance simplify network troubleshooting and diagnostics? (Choose two.)

options.A: Using streaming telemetry to gain real-time insight from devices
options.B: Simplifying the provisioning workflow for new devices
options.C: Using open APIs to integrate with other platforms for extra context
options.D: Adding Plug and Play onboarding for new devices

questions.explanation_es: La telemetría en streaming aporta visibilidad casi en tiempo real del estado de los dispositivos, y las API abiertas permiten integrar información contextual de otras plataformas; Plug and Play y la simplificación del aprovisionamiento están relacionados con otras funciones de DNA Center, no directamente con el diagnóstico de Assurance.

questions.name: Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which Cisco DNA/Catalyst Center section translates business intent into network policies, such as access control, traffic routing, and QoS, applied consistently across the wired and wireless infrastructure?

options.A: Assurance
options.B: Provision
options.C: Design
options.D: Policy

questions.explanation_es: La sección Policy de Cisco DNA Center traduce la intención de negocio en políticas de red (control de acceso, enrutamiento de tráfico, QoS) que se aplican de forma consistente en toda la infraestructura cableada e inalámbrica.

questions.name: Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which four sections make up the Cisco DNA/Catalyst Center dashboard workflow? (Choose four.)

options.A: Policy
options.B: Provision
options.C: Design
options.D: Assurance

questions.explanation_es: Los cuatro bloques principales del flujo de trabajo de Cisco DNA Center son Design, Policy, Provision y Assurance; Automation no es uno de esos cuatro apartados con ese nombre.

questions.name: Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which capability of Cisco DNA/Catalyst Center Assurance allows context-aware baselining, capturing how the relationship between metrics changes as network conditions evolve?

options.A: Machine learning algorithms
options.B: The Network Health and Client Health dashboards
options.C: User-defined network segmentation
options.D: Device 360 / Client 360

questions.explanation_es: Los algoritmos de machine learning de Cisco DNA Center Assurance permiten un baselining sensible al contexto, actualizando de forma continua la relación óptima entre métricas a medida que cambian las condiciones de la red.

questions.name: Catalyst Center
questions.question: Which Cisco DNA/Catalyst Center Assurance feature provides a historical, timeline-based view of a specific device or client, including topology, throughput, and latency at different points in time?

options.A: User-Defined Network
options.B: Device 360 / Client 360
options.C: Network Health dashboard
options.D: Path Trace only

questions.explanation_es: Device 360/Client 360 ofrece una vista basada en línea de tiempo de un dispositivo o cliente concreto, mostrando información como topología, rendimiento y latencia en distintos momentos.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: Which transport protocol does NETCONF rely on to secure communication between client and server?

options.A: IPsec
options.B: TLS over TCP
options.C: SSH
options.D: Plain HTTP

questions.explanation_es: NETCONF utiliza SSH como transporte entre el cliente y el servidor, lo que garantiza confidencialidad, integridad y autenticidad en la comunicación.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: In the context of RESTCONF, what do the CRUD operations represent?

options.A: Create, Read, Update, Delete
options.B: Commit, Rollback, Undo, Deploy
options.C: Configure, Report, Update, Diagnose
options.D: Connect, Retrieve, Upload, Disconnect

questions.explanation_es: CRUD hace referencia a las operaciones Create, Read, Update y Delete que RESTCONF aplica sobre un almacén de datos conceptual definido por modelos YANG.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: Which NETCONF operation is used to load all or part of a configuration into a specified target configuration datastore?

options.A: get
options.B: get-config
options.C: edit-config
options.D: copy-config

questions.explanation_es: La operación edit-config carga la totalidad o una parte de una configuración especificada en el almacén de configuración de destino indicado.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: What is the purpose of the candidate configuration datastore in NETCONF?

options.A: It permanently replaces the running configuration as soon as it is created
options.B: It stores a read-only copy of the device's startup configuration, kept for comparison purposes rather than as an editable workspace for changes destined for the running configuration
options.C: It provides a temporary workspace holding a copy of the configuration that can be edited before being committed
options.D: It stores only the factory-default configuration

questions.explanation_es: El almacén de configuración candidate ofrece un espacio de trabajo temporal donde se guarda una copia de la configuración que puede modificarse y luego confirmarse (commit) para aplicarla a la configuración en ejecución.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: When a NETCONF client connects to a NETCONF server, what type of session is established between them?

options.A: An unencrypted Telnet session
options.B: An unauthenticated TCP session
options.C: A TLS session over UDP
options.D: An SSH session

questions.explanation_es: El cliente NETCONF establece una sesión SSH con el servidor NETCONF, sobre la cual se intercambian los mensajes RPC codificados en XML.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: Which command verifies that the software processes required for NETCONF and RESTCONF, such as nginx and confd, are running on a Cisco IOS XE device?

options.A: show netconf-yang statistics
options.B: show platform software yang-management process
options.C: show netconf-yang sessions details
options.D: show netconf-yang sessions

questions.explanation_es: El comando show platform software yang-management process permite verificar el estado de los procesos de software (como nginx y confd) necesarios para que NETCONF y RESTCONF funcionen correctamente.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: True or false: NETCONF relies on a Remote Procedure Call (RPC) based mechanism for communication between client and server.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: NETCONF se basa en un mecanismo de llamada a procedimiento remoto (RPC) codificado en XML para la comunicación entre el cliente y el servidor.

questions.name: NETCONF/RESTCONF
questions.question: True or false: RESTCONF is based on JSON and SSH.

options.A: False
options.B: True

questions.explanation_es: RESTCONF se basa en JSON y HTTP (no SSH); es NETCONF-YANG el que utiliza un modelo de transporte basado en SSH.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: Among the Cisco IOS password types, which one provides the weakest protection because it is trivially reversible with widely available tools?

options.A: Type 9 (scrypt)
options.B: Type 7 (Vigenere-style obfuscation)
options.C: Type 8 (PBKDF2 with SHA-256)
options.D: Type 5 (MD5 hash)

questions.explanation_es: El tipo 7 usa una ofuscación reversible (estilo Vigenere) que puede desencriptarse fácilmente con herramientas públicas, mientras que los tipos 8 y 9 usan funciones de hash robustas y el tipo 5 usa MD5, más resistente que el tipo 7.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: Which encryption type is applied to plaintext passwords already present in the running configuration when an administrator issues the service password-encryption command?

options.A: Type 5
options.B: Type 7
options.C: Type 9
options.D: Type 0

questions.explanation_es: El comando service password-encryption aplica un cifrado tipo 7 (reversible) a las contraseñas en texto claro almacenadas en la configuración.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: What correctly describes the difference between the "login" and "login local" line configuration commands? (Choose two.)

options.A: "login" enables authentication using only a configured line password
options.B: "login local" enables authentication against locally configured usernames and passwords
options.C: "login local" enables authentication using only a configured line password
options.D: "login" enables authentication against a locally configured username database

questions.explanation_es: El comando "login" solicita únicamente la contraseña de línea configurada, mientras que "login local" exige un usuario y contraseña validados contra la base de datos local del dispositivo.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: A user authenticates to a router and lands at privilege level 0 instead of the usual user EXEC level. Which of the following commands can this user still execute? (Choose two.)

options.A: disable
options.B: configure terminal
options.C: show running-config
options.D: logout

questions.explanation_es: El nivel de privilegio 0 solo habilita un conjunto mínimo de comandos (disable, enable, exit, help y logout); comandos como show running-config o configure terminal requieren niveles de privilegio más altos.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: An administrator wants the vty lines on a router to accept only inbound SSH sessions and reject Telnet entirely. Which two configuration elements accomplish this? (Choose two.)

options.A: transport input all under line vty configuration
options.B: An extended ACL permitting only TCP port 22, applied inbound with access-class on the vty lines
options.C: transport input ssh under line vty configuration
options.D: transport output ssh under line vty configuration

questions.explanation_es: "transport input ssh" impide que se acepten conexiones Telnet en las líneas vty, y una ACL extendida aplicada con access-class que permita solo el puerto TCP 22 añade una restricción adicional por origen.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: What is the first practical step recommended to secure user EXEC access on a Cisco IOS device before deploying a centralized AAA solution?

options.A: Configure passwords for local and remote CLI sessions
options.B: Raise the enable secret to privilege level 15
options.C: Deploy a TACACS+ server for authentication
options.D: Enable SSH version 2 on all vty lines

questions.explanation_es: Antes de implementar AAA centralizado, el paso básico inicial es configurar contraseñas locales para las sesiones CLI locales (consola) y remotas (vty), estableciendo una línea base de seguridad.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: Which line configuration command is typically applied under the auxiliary line to prevent remote administrative access through a dial-up modem?

options.A: no exec
options.B: login local
options.C: transport input none
options.D: exec-timeout 0 0

questions.explanation_es: El comando "no exec" bajo "line aux 0" deshabilita la posibilidad de iniciar una sesión EXEC a través del puerto auxiliar, evitando el acceso remoto vía módem.

questions.name: Líneas y autenticación local
questions.question: Why can a device running only SSHv1 not establish a management session with a peer configured to support only SSHv2?

options.A: SSHv2 works only with certificate-based authentication
options.B: SSHv1 requires a RADIUS server for key exchange that SSHv2 does not support
options.C: SSHv1 and SSHv2 are incompatible protocol versions and cannot interoperate with each other
options.D: SSHv2 uses TCP port 23 while SSHv1 uses port 22

questions.explanation_es: SSHv2 introdujo cambios de protocolo que lo hacen incompatible con SSHv1; un dispositivo limitado a SSHv1 no puede negociar una sesión con un peer configurado exclusivamente para SSHv2.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: True or false: Configuring "aaa authorization exec default group ISE-TACACS+ if-authenticated" automatically forces EXEC authorization on the console line as well as on the vty lines.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: Por defecto, la autorización EXEC del método "default" no se aplica automáticamente a la línea de consola; se requiere el comando adicional "aaa authorization console" para forzarla también allí.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: Which AAA function is primarily responsible for logging the specific commands a user executes on a network device?

options.A: Auditing
options.B: Authorization
options.C: Accounting
options.D: Authentication

questions.explanation_es: La función de accounting (contabilidad) registra la actividad de la sesión, incluidos los comandos ejecutados, para fines de auditoría y generación de reportes.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: Which protocol is generally preferred for controlling and auditing administrative access to network devices, due to its command-level authorization granularity?

options.A: TACACS+
options.B: Telnet
options.C: SSHv2
options.D: RADIUS

questions.explanation_es: TACACS+ separa autenticación, autorización y contabilidad y permite autorizar comandos individuales, lo que lo hace más adecuado que RADIUS para el control de acceso administrativo a dispositivos.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: Over which port and transport protocol does a TACACS+ client communicate with a TACACS+ server?

options.A: TCP port 49
options.B: UDP port 49
options.C: UDP port 1812
options.D: TCP port 389

questions.explanation_es: TACACS+ utiliza el puerto TCP 49 para la comunicación entre el cliente (dispositivo de red) y el servidor TACACS+.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: What is a key advantage of using a centralized AAA server (RADIUS or TACACS+) instead of configuring local authentication independently on every network device?

options.A: It allows console ports to bypass authentication entirely
options.B: It eliminates the need to ever configure a local fallback account
options.C: It provides standardized, scalable authentication management across many devices
options.D: It removes the requirement for encrypted management protocols like SSH

questions.explanation_es: Centralizar la autenticación en un servidor AAA aporta escalabilidad y consistencia en los métodos de autenticación en todos los dispositivos, evitando configurar cada uno de forma individual.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT typically presented as a benefit of deploying AAA on network devices?

options.A: Complete elimination of the need for any local user accounts
options.B: Standardized authentication using RADIUS or TACACS+
options.C: Scalability across many devices
options.D: Increased flexibility and control over access configuration

questions.explanation_es: Aun con AAA desplegado, se recomienda mantener una cuenta local como respaldo por si el servidor AAA no está disponible, por lo que AAA no elimina por completo la necesidad de usuarios locales.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: In the commonly used implementation of RADIUS, which UDP port is designated for accounting traffic?

options.A: UDP port 1645
options.B: UDP port 1646
options.C: UDP port 1813
options.D: UDP port 1812

questions.explanation_es: La implementación estándar de RADIUS usa el puerto UDP 1813 para el tráfico de accounting, mientras que el 1812 se usa para autenticación/autorización.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: Which global configuration command must be entered before any AAA authentication, authorization, or accounting statements can take effect on a Cisco IOS device?

options.A: aaa accounting exec default
options.B: aaa authentication login default
options.C: aaa authorization network default
options.D: aaa new-model

questions.explanation_es: "aaa new-model" habilita el subsistema AAA en el dispositivo; sin este comando, las demás sentencias de autenticación, autorización y contabilidad no surten efecto.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: Which types of devices can act as a TACACS+ network access server (NAS) requesting services from a TACACS+ daemon?

options.A: Only routers
options.B: Routers, switches, and access points
options.C: Only switches
options.D: Only wireless access points

questions.explanation_es: Cualquier dispositivo de red que actúe como cliente TACACS+ (router, switch o access point) puede funcionar como NAS que solicita servicios de autenticación al servidor TACACS+.

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: An administrator created a AAA authentication method list named "list1" and wants a specific vty line to use it instead of the default list. Which line configuration command accomplishes this?

options.A: aaa authentication login list1
options.B: aaa new-model list1
options.C: aaa authorization exec list1
options.D: login authentication list1

questions.explanation_es: El comando "login authentication list1", aplicado en modo de configuración de línea, vincula esa línea al método de autenticación personalizado llamado "list1".

questions.name: AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS)
questions.question: After entering "tacacs server MYSERVER" in IOS 15.x, which subcommand specifies the server's IPv4 address (for example, 10.10.10.10)?

options.A: address ipv4 10.10.10.10
options.B: ip tacacs-server 10.10.10.10
options.C: aaa tacacs 10.10.10.10

questions.explanation_es: Dentro del submodo de configuración del servidor TACACS+, el comando "address ipv4 10.10.10.10" especifica la dirección IP del servidor.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: Which interface configuration command applies an IPv4 access list to filter traffic on that interface?

options.A: ip access-group {number|name} {in|out}
options.B: access-list apply {number|name} {in|out}
options.C: ip access-class {number|name} {in|out}
options.D: ip access-list {number|name} {in|out}

questions.explanation_es: "ip access-group" es el comando de interfaz usado para aplicar una ACL numerada o nombrada al tráfico entrante o saliente de esa interfaz.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: What is a practical advantage of using named ACLs instead of numbered ACLs?

options.A: Named ACLs support wildcard masks while numbered ACLs do not
options.B: Named ACLs allow individual entries to be added, removed, or resequenced without recreating the entire list
options.C: Named ACLs can only be applied to VLAN interfaces
options.D: Named ACLs bypass the implicit deny at the end of the list

questions.explanation_es: Las ACL con nombre permiten editar entradas individuales (añadir, eliminar o reordenar por número de secuencia) sin tener que recrear toda la lista, a diferencia de una ACL numerada clásica.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: Which command is used to apply a port ACL (PACL) filtering IPv4 traffic to a Layer 2 switchport interface?

options.A: mac access-group access-list-name in
options.B: vlan filter access-list-name vlan-list
options.C: ip access-class access-list-name {in|out}
options.D: ip access-group access-list-name {in|out}

questions.explanation_es: Al igual que en un router, "ip access-group" se usa para aplicar la ACL IPv4 a la interfaz de Capa 2 del switch; para filtrado por dirección MAC se emplea en cambio "mac access-group".

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: How many access lists can be applied to a single interface, per protocol and per direction (inbound or outbound)?

options.A: Up to two
options.B: Only one
options.C: An unlimited number
options.D: Up to four

questions.explanation_es: Por diseño de Cisco IOS, solo se puede aplicar una ACL por protocolo y por dirección en cada interfaz.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: Which command applies a previously defined VLAN access-map to a specific VLAN or set of VLANs, creating a VACL?

options.A: ip access-class access-list-name {in|out}
options.B: vlan filter map-name vlan-list
options.C: vlan access-map map-name
options.D: ip access-group access-list-name {in|out}

questions.explanation_es: "vlan filter map-name vlan-list" asocia un VLAN access-map ya definido a una VLAN específica, un rango de VLANs, o una lista separada por comas.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: To which of the following can a port ACL (PACL) be applied? (Choose two.)

options.A: A Layer 2 access switchport
options.B: A trunk port
options.C: A Layer 3 routed subinterface
options.D: A VLAN interface (SVI)

questions.explanation_es: Las PACL se aplican a puertos de Capa 2 de un switch, incluyendo puertos de acceso y puertos trunk; no se aplican a SVIs (eso corresponde a las VACL) ni a subinterfaces enrutadas de Capa 3.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: Which two types of access lists are specifically designed to filter traffic in a Layer 2 switching environment, as opposed to a routed Layer 3 interface?

options.A: Standard numbered ACLs
options.B: VLAN ACLs (VACLs)
options.C: Extended numbered ACLs
options.D: Port ACLs (PACLs)

questions.explanation_es: Las PACL se aplican a puertos de Capa 2 y las VACL a VLANs; las ACL estándar y extendidas clásicas están orientadas a interfaces enrutadas de Capa 3.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: Once an incoming packet matches an access control entry (ACE) within an ACL, what happens next?

options.A: The packet is queued until all ACEs have been checked for a possible better match
options.B: The permit or deny action for that ACE is applied, and evaluation of the remaining ACEs stops
options.C: Evaluation always continues through every remaining ACE regardless of the match
options.D: Only deny actions stop further evaluation; permit actions continue checking subsequent ACEs

questions.explanation_es: El procesamiento de una ACL es secuencial y de primera coincidencia: en cuanto se encuentra una ACE que coincide, se aplica su acción (permit o deny) y se detiene la evaluación del resto de la lista.

questions.name: ACLs
questions.question: A VLAN ACL's (VACL) VLAN list can reference all of the following EXCEPT:

options.A: Individual Layer 2 switchports
options.B: A comma-separated list of multiple VLANs
options.C: A single VLAN
options.D: A range of VLANs

questions.explanation_es: La lista de VLANs de una VACL puede especificar una VLAN individual, un rango, o una lista separada por comas, pero no puede hacer referencia directa a puertos de Capa 2 individuales.

questions.name: CoPP
questions.question: Which Cisco IOS feature was developed specifically to protect a router's route processor (RP) or CPU from being overwhelmed by excessive or malicious traffic?

options.A: Control Plane Policing (CoPP)
options.B: AAA
options.C: Zone-Based Firewall (ZBFW)
options.D: Standard ACLs applied inbound on every interface

questions.explanation_es: CoPP fue diseñado específicamente para proteger el plano de control (la CPU/RP) de un router o switch frente a tráfico excesivo o de tipo DoS, priorizando el tráfico de control importante.

questions.name: CoPP
questions.question: True or false: Control Plane Policing (CoPP) can apply separate service policies for traffic entering and traffic leaving the control plane.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: CoPP admite políticas de servicio tanto de entrada como de salida sobre el plano de control, aunque en la práctica la política de entrada es la que se utiliza con más frecuencia.

questions.name: CoPP
questions.question: What is the primary reason an administrator would implement CoPP on a Cisco IOS router?

options.A: To encrypt management traffic destined to the router itself
options.B: To translate private addresses destined to the control plane
options.C: To protect the route processor from unnecessary or denial-of-service traffic while prioritizing legitimate control-plane traffic
options.D: To load-balance traffic across multiple WAN links

questions.explanation_es: El objetivo principal de CoPP es blindar al RP frente a tráfico innecesario o de denegación de servicio, dando prioridad al tráfico de control y gestión legítimo.

questions.name: CoPP
questions.question: Which command displays whether a CoPP service policy has been successfully applied to the control plane, along with its matching statistics?

options.A: show running-config | include copp
options.B: show access-lists control-plane
options.C: show policy-map control-plane
options.D: show ip interface control-plane

questions.explanation_es: "show policy-map control-plane" muestra la política de servicio aplicada al plano de control, junto con las estadísticas de coincidencia de cada clase.

questions.name: CoPP
questions.question: In a CoPP configuration, which construct groups previously defined ACLs together in order to classify traffic before a policy action is applied?

options.A: A service map
options.B: A route map
options.C: The ACL itself, applied directly with ip access-group
options.D: A class map

questions.explanation_es: El class-map utiliza las ACL ya creadas para clasificar el tráfico según protocolos, direcciones u otros criterios, antes de que la policy-map defina la acción a aplicar sobre cada clase.

questions.name: CoPP
questions.question: Which command attaches a previously defined CoPP policy map to the control plane so it actually takes effect?

options.A: service-policy {input|output} policy-name, entered in control-plane configuration mode
options.B: class-map
options.C: policy-map
options.D: ip access-group policy-name control-plane

questions.explanation_es: El comando "service-policy", aplicado dentro del modo de configuración de control-plane, es el que vincula la policy-map al plano de control para que la política surta efecto.

questions.name: CoPP
questions.question: True or false: CoPP is configured and enforced on a per-interface basis, similar to a standard interface ACL.

options.A: False
options.B: True

questions.explanation_es: A diferencia de una ACL de interfaz, CoPP se aplica de forma global al dispositivo, ya que protege el plano de control del equipo en su conjunto y no una interfaz en particular.

questions.name: Seguridad de REST API
questions.question: In an SDN architecture, which API type does a controller use to expose network state and control to business applications and orchestration services running above it?

options.A: East-West API
options.B: Northbound API
options.C: Southbound API
options.D: A dedicated management-only API separate from REST

questions.explanation_es: La API northbound es la que expone el controlador SDN hacia las aplicaciones y servicios de orquestación que se ejecutan por encima de él, permitiendo que esas aplicaciones consuman los datos y funciones de red del controlador.

questions.name: Seguridad de REST API
questions.question: When Cisco ISE integrates with Cisco DNA Center to secure their communication channel, what type of credential does ISE present as its identity?

options.A: An X.509 v3 certificate
options.B: A Kerberos ticket
options.C: A self-signed PGP key
options.D: A shared pre-shared key (PSK) only, without certificates

questions.explanation_es: ISE utiliza un certificado de identidad X.509 v3 para autenticarse y asegurar la comunicación con Cisco DNA Center, en lugar de depender únicamente de credenciales compartidas.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: What is the name of the overarching Cisco security architecture framework used to design secure solutions across different places in the network (PINs)?

options.A: Cisco Validated Design (CVD)
options.B: Cisco Threat Response
options.C: Cisco Secure Malware Analytics
options.D: Cisco SAFE

questions.explanation_es: Cisco SAFE es el marco de referencia de arquitectura de seguridad que Cisco define para diseñar soluciones seguras en los distintos lugares de la red (PINs).

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which three of the following are recognized "Places in the Network" (PINs) in the Cisco SAFE framework?

options.A: Edge
options.B: Campus
options.C: Data center
options.D: Internet

questions.explanation_es: Campus, centro de datos y edge son PINs reconocidos dentro de Cisco SAFE; "Internet" no es en sí un PIN, sino la red externa con la que se conecta el PIN de Edge.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which three of the following are secure domains defined within the Cisco SAFE framework?

options.A: Compliance
options.B: Threat defense
options.C: Segregation
options.D: Segmentation

questions.explanation_es: Threat defense, segmentación y compliance son dominios seguros reconocidos por Cisco SAFE; "segregación" no es un dominio oficial del framework.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which Cisco organization is dedicated to threat intelligence research, tracking threats across endpoints, networks, cloud, web, and email?

options.A: Cisco Secure Network Analytics
options.B: The standalone Cisco TRAC team
options.C: Cisco Talos
options.D: Cisco Secure Malware Analytics

questions.explanation_es: Cisco Talos es la organización de inteligencia de amenazas de Cisco, formada por la unión de varios equipos de investigación de seguridad, incluido el antiguo equipo TRAC.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: What best describes Cisco Secure Malware Analytics (formerly Threat Grid)?

options.A: The overarching Cisco security architecture framework
options.B: A NetFlow-based network traffic analytics tool
options.C: A sandboxing solution that performs static and dynamic (behavioral) analysis of files to determine whether they are malicious
options.D: The organization that produces Cisco's global threat intelligence feeds

questions.explanation_es: Cisco Secure Malware Analytics ejecuta archivos sospechosos en un entorno sandbox controlado y realiza análisis estático y dinámico (de comportamiento) para determinar si son maliciosos.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which Cisco solution primarily relies on NetFlow telemetry from the network infrastructure to detect anomalous or malicious behavior?

options.A: Cisco Secure Web Appliance
options.B: Cisco Secure Network Analytics
options.C: Cisco Secure Malware Analytics
options.D: Cisco Talos

questions.explanation_es: Cisco Secure Network Analytics (antes Stealthwatch) se apoya en telemetría NetFlow generada por la infraestructura de red para detectar comportamientos anómalos o maliciosos.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which two of the following discovery protocols are commonly disabled on infrastructure devices as a hardening best practice, since they advertise device and topology information? (Choose two.)

options.A: Zone-Based Firewall (ZBFW)
options.B: Cisco Discovery Protocol (CDP)
options.C: Control Plane Policing (CoPP)
options.D: Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP)

questions.explanation_es: CDP y LLDP anuncian información del dispositivo y la topología en el segmento local; deshabilitarlos en interfaces no confiables reduce la superficie de reconocimiento disponible para un atacante.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Within the Cisco SAFE PIN model, in which PIN are the majority of an organization's critical information assets typically located?

options.A: Edge
options.B: WAN
options.C: Branch
options.D: Data center

questions.explanation_es: El centro de datos es el PIN donde normalmente reside la mayoría de los activos de información críticos de una organización, lo que lo convierte en un objetivo prioritario de protección.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which Cisco SAFE PIN is generally considered the highest-risk location because it is the primary point where public Internet traffic enters and corporate traffic exits?

options.A: WAN
options.B: Branch
options.C: Edge
options.D: Campus

questions.explanation_es: El PIN de Edge se considera el de mayor riesgo porque es el principal punto de ingreso de tráfico público de Internet y de salida del tráfico corporativo hacia Internet.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which Cisco security solution is agentless and relies on machine learning and behavioral modeling of network telemetry to detect emerging threats?

options.A: Cisco Umbrella
options.B: Cisco AMP
options.C: Cisco Secure Network Analytics
options.D: Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect)

questions.explanation_es: Cisco Secure Network Analytics no requiere agentes en los endpoints; analiza telemetría de red mediante aprendizaje automático y modelado de comportamiento para detectar amenazas emergentes.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which Cisco SAFE secure domain focuses on the global detection and aggregation of emerging malware intelligence?

options.A: Segmentation
options.B: Security intelligence
options.C: Compliance
options.D: Threat defense

questions.explanation_es: El dominio de inteligencia de seguridad se centra en la detección global y la agregación de información sobre malware emergente y otras amenazas.

questions.name: Threat defense
questions.question: Which Cisco cloud security solution blocks connections to malware, ransomware, phishing sites, and botnet command-and-control infrastructure at the DNS and IP layers, before a session is even established?

options.A: Cisco Umbrella
options.B: Cisco Secure Network Analytics
options.C: Cisco AMP
options.D: Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect)

questions.explanation_es: Cisco Umbrella actúa en la capa DNS/IP para bloquear el acceso a dominios e IPs asociados a malware, ransomware, phishing y botnets antes de que se establezca la conexión.

questions.name: Seguridad de endpoint (NAC/ISE)
questions.question: True or false: Cisco pxGrid functionality requires Cisco ISE, since ISE hosts the pxGrid controller that shares contextual data with integrated security platforms.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: pxGrid depende de Cisco ISE, que actúa como el controlador pxGrid encargado de compartir información contextual con las plataformas de seguridad integradas.

questions.name: Seguridad de endpoint (NAC/ISE)
questions.question: Which EAP method supports EAP chaining, allowing both machine and user credentials to be validated within a single authentication exchange?

options.A: EAP-TTLS
options.B: PEAP
options.C: EAP-FAST
options.D: EAP-GTC

questions.explanation_es: EAP-FAST admite el encadenamiento de EAP (EAP chaining), que permite validar las credenciales de máquina y de usuario dentro del mismo intercambio de autenticación.

questions.name: Seguridad de endpoint (NAC/ISE)
questions.question: Which authentication mechanism is typically used as a fallback for devices that cannot perform 802.1X supplicant-based authentication?

options.A: Central Web Authentication
options.B: TACACS+ authorization
options.C: EAP-TLS
options.D: MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB)

questions.explanation_es: MAB (MAC Authentication Bypass) se usa como mecanismo de respaldo para autenticar dispositivos que no cuentan con un suplicante 802.1X, basándose en su dirección MAC.

questions.name: Seguridad de endpoint (NAC/ISE)
questions.question: Which type of web authentication supports advanced services such as client provisioning, posture assessment, acceptable-use-policy acknowledgment, and self- or device-registration?

options.A: Central Web Authentication
options.B: Guest Web Authentication configured directly on the switch
options.C: Local Web Authentication
options.D: Open Authentication with WebAuth passthrough

questions.explanation_es: La autenticación web centralizada (Central Web Authentication), gestionada desde ISE, habilita servicios avanzados como el aprovisionamiento del cliente, la evaluación de postura, el reconocimiento de políticas de uso aceptable y el autorregistro de dispositivos.

questions.name: TrustSec/MACsec
questions.question: True or false: A Security Group Tag (SGT) is propagated all the way down into the endpoint's own network stack or software.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: El SGT se asigna e inserta en la red de acceso (switches, routers, firewalls), pero no se propaga hasta el software o la pila de red del propio endpoint.

questions.name: TrustSec/MACsec
questions.question: Which three phases make up the Cisco TrustSec model?

options.A: Enforcement
options.B: Propagation
options.C: Distribution
options.D: Classification

questions.explanation_es: TrustSec se compone de tres fases: clasificación (asignación del SGT), propagación (difusión del SGT hasta el punto de aplicación) y enforcement (control del tráfico según el SGT).

questions.name: TrustSec/MACsec
questions.question: What is the name of Cisco's software-defined segmentation technology that dynamically groups endpoints into logical Security Groups instead of relying on IP addresses or VLANs?

options.A: Cisco DNA Center Assurance
options.B: Cisco ACI
options.C: Cisco SD-Access Fabric
options.D: Cisco TrustSec

questions.explanation_es: Cisco TrustSec es la solución de segmentación definida por software que agrupa dinámicamente a los endpoints en grupos de seguridad lógicos basados en contexto de negocio, no en direcciones IP o VLANs.

questions.name: TrustSec/MACsec
questions.question: In the Cisco TrustSec model, which phase is responsible for actually restricting or permitting traffic based on the SGT carried by a packet?

options.A: Propagation
options.B: Assignment
options.C: Enforcement
options.D: Classification

questions.explanation_es: La fase de enforcement (aplicación) es la que controla el tráfico basándose en la etiqueta SGT, normalmente en un switch, router o firewall.

questions.name: TrustSec/MACsec
questions.question: In the Cisco TrustSec model, during which phase are users or devices assigned to a Security Group as they connect to the network?

options.A: Propagation
options.B: Enforcement
options.C: Assignment
options.D: Classification

questions.explanation_es: La fase de clasificación es cuando se asigna un usuario o dispositivo a un grupo de seguridad al conectarse a la red, ya sea de forma dinámica (tras la autenticación) o estática.

questions.name: TrustSec/MACsec
questions.question: True or false: MACsec encryption is enabled on a per-link (per-port) basis rather than applied globally across an entire switch.

options.A: False
options.B: True

questions.explanation_es: MACsec se habilita puerto por puerto (enlace por enlace), aprovechando el soporte de hardware (ASIC) de cada puerto, y no de forma global en todo el switch.

questions.name: TrustSec/MACsec
questions.question: In Cisco TrustSec, which SGT classification method downloads the tag dynamically from ISE as part of an 802.1X, MAB, or WebAuth authentication exchange?

options.A: Inline tagging
options.B: SXP-based mapping
options.C: Static assignment
options.D: Dynamic assignment

questions.explanation_es: En la asignación dinámica, el SGT se descarga desde ISE como parte del resultado de la autenticación 802.1x, MAB o WebAuth, sin necesidad de configuración manual en el dispositivo.

questions.name: TrustSec/MACsec
questions.question: True or false: "Downlink" MACsec refers to encrypting the link between two switches in the network core.

options.A: False
options.B: True

questions.explanation_es: El MACsec "downlink" cifra el enlace entre un endpoint y el switch de acceso; el cifrado entre switches se conoce como MACsec "uplink" o de infraestructura.

questions.name: Hypervisor tipo 1 y 2
questions.question: Which type of hypervisor is most commonly deployed in enterprise production data centers?

options.A: A Type 2 hypervisor, because it integrates directly with the desktop operating system
options.B: A hosted hypervisor that runs as an application on top of Windows Server
options.C: A Type 1 (bare-metal) hypervisor, because it runs directly on the physical hardware
options.D: A nested hypervisor that runs inside another virtual machine

questions.explanation_es: El hipervisor tipo 1 (bare-metal) se instala directamente sobre el hardware físico sin necesitar un sistema operativo anfitrión, lo que le da mejor rendimiento y estabilidad; por eso es el más usado en despliegues de producción empresarial.

questions.name: VMs / FT / DRS
questions.question: Which statement best defines a virtual machine (VM)?

options.A: A lightweight process that shares the host kernel and never emulates hardware
options.B: A software emulation of a physical server that never includes an operating system
options.C: A software emulation of a physical server, including its own guest operating system
options.D: An isolated file-system namespace used only to package application dependencies

questions.explanation_es: Una VM es la emulación por software de un servidor físico completo, que incluye su propio sistema operativo invitado, a diferencia de un contenedor, que solo empaqueta la aplicación y sus dependencias sobre el kernel del host.

questions.name: VMs / FT / DRS
questions.question: In the context of server virtualization, what does the term "consolidation ratio" describe?

options.A: The ratio of physical NICs to virtual NICs configured on a hypervisor
options.B: The number of virtual CPUs allocated to a single virtual machine
options.C: The ratio of virtual machines running on a single physical host compared to that host
options.D: The percentage of a VM's allocated memory that is actively in use

questions.explanation_es: La relación de consolidación (consolidation ratio) indica cuántas máquinas virtuales se ejecutan sobre un mismo servidor físico, reflejando cuánto se está aprovechando el hardware gracias a la virtualización.

questions.name: VMs / FT / DRS
questions.question: From the perspective of the hypervisor, how is a virtual machine's virtual disk typically represented?

options.A: As a dedicated physical disk partition mapped directly to the VM through raw device mapping, bypassing the hypervisor's own file system for that VM's storage I/O
options.B: As a remote iSCSI target that bypasses the hypervisor's file system entirely
options.C: As a reserved block of host RAM used for the VM's storage I/O
options.D: As one or more files stored on the storage attached to the hypervisor host

questions.explanation_es: El hipervisor representa el disco de una VM como uno o varios archivos (por ejemplo, VMDK o VHD) ubicados en el almacenamiento conectado al host, lo que facilita operaciones como clonado, snapshots y migración en caliente.

questions.name: vSwitch/OVS
questions.question: Which statement best describes a virtual switch (vSwitch)?

options.A: A software-based Layer 3 device that routes traffic between VM subnets
options.B: A dedicated hardware NIC that offloads all switching decisions from the hypervisor's CPU
options.C: A software-based Layer 2 switch that lets VMs communicate with each other and with the physical network
options.D: A clustering technology that binds several physical switches into one logical switching system

questions.explanation_es: Un vSwitch es un switch de Capa 2 implementado en software dentro del hipervisor; permite que las VMs se comuniquen entre sí y con la red física a través de las NIC físicas (pNIC) del servidor.

questions.name: vSwitch/OVS
questions.question: True or false: A virtualized server can have only a single virtual switch instance running on it at any given time.

options.A: False, a virtualized server can run multiple vSwitches, although traffic cannot flow directly between them
options.B: True, because a physical NIC can only ever be bound to one vSwitch across the whole data center
options.C: True, because the hypervisor kernel exposes only one virtual switch port group per host
options.D: False, but only when the host is running a Type 2 hypervisor instead of Type 1

questions.explanation_es: Un servidor virtualizado puede tener varios vSwitches configurados al mismo tiempo, pero el tráfico no puede pasar directamente de un vSwitch a otro dentro del mismo host; para lograrlo se necesitaría un dispositivo intermedio, como un firewall virtual, que conecte ambos segmentos.

questions.name: vSwitch/OVS
questions.question: Do containerized workloads sharing the same host still need a virtual switch or virtual bridge to communicate with each other and with the outside network?

options.A: No, containers attach directly to the host's physical NIC and bypass any virtual switching layer
options.B: No, containers exchange traffic only through shared memory segments, so no switching layer is involved
options.C: Yes, containers rely on a virtual switch or bridge, such as Docker's default bridge, much like VMs rely on a vSwitch
options.D: Yes, but only when the containers are being managed by a Kubernetes orchestrator

questions.explanation_es: Al igual que las VMs, los contenedores dependen de un switch o puente virtual (por ejemplo, el bridge docker0) para comunicarse entre sí dentro del mismo nodo y con el exterior, ya que el motor de contenedores no conecta sus interfaces directamente al NIC físico.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: Which statement best describes Python's reputation among network engineers learning automation?

options.A: Python is widely considered one of the more approachable languages for newcomers to programming.
options.B: Python code must be compiled into a platform-specific binary before it can run.
options.C: Python requires manual memory management similar to C, making it hard for beginners.
options.D: Python enforces strict static typing that must be declared for every variable.

questions.explanation_es: Python es ampliamente considerado uno de los lenguajes más accesibles para principiantes gracias a su sintaxis simple y legible, por lo que se usa mucho en automatización de redes. Las otras opciones describen características que no aplican a Python, como la gestión manual de memoria, la compilación obligatoria a binario o el tipado estático estricto.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: In Python, what are two valid uses of a set of three consecutive quotation marks (''' or """)? (Choose two.)

options.A: To declare a new function definition
options.B: To mark the beginning of a multi-line string
options.C: To represent a logical OR comparison
options.D: To mark the end of a multi-line string

questions.explanation_es: Las triples comillas se usan para abrir y cerrar cadenas de texto que abarcan varias líneas, como los docstrings o strings multilínea. No se usan para definir funciones, ya que para eso se emplea la palabra clave "def", ni para representar un OR lógico, que se escribe con la palabra "or".

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: Which of the following code snippets correctly represents a Python dictionary?

options.A: print(dnac_devices)
options.B: { "host": "sandboxdnac.cisco.com", "port": 443, "username": "devnetuser", "password": "Cisco123!" }
options.C: def dnac_login(host, username, password): return requests.get(url)
options.D: [users[root|Jason|Jamie|Luke]]

questions.explanation_es: Un diccionario en Python se define con llaves y pares clave-valor separados por comas, tal como se ve en la opción A. La opción B no corresponde a una sintaxis válida de Python, la opción C es la definición de una función y la opción D es simplemente una llamada a la función print().

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: Which two of the following represent the definition or invocation of a Python function? (Choose two.)

options.A: def dnac_login(host, username, password): return requests.get(url).json()
options.B: dnac = { "host": "sandboxdnac.cisco.com", "port": 443 }
options.C: print(dnac_devices)
options.D: [users[root|Jason|Jamie|Luke]]

questions.explanation_es: La opción C define una función usando la palabra clave "def", y la opción D invoca la función incorporada print(). La opción A es un diccionario y la opción B no es sintaxis válida de Python.

questions.name: JSON
questions.question: Which of the following data samples is formatted as valid JSON?

options.A: <users><user><name>root</name></user></users>
options.B: [users[root|Jason|Jamie|Luke]]
options.C: root Jason Jamie Luke
options.D: { "user": "root", "father": "Jason", "mother": "Jamie", "friend": "Luke" }

questions.explanation_es: JSON representa los datos como pares clave-valor encerrados entre llaves, tal como se muestra en la opción A. La opción B es XML porque usa etiquetas, la opción C es texto plano sin estructura y la opción D no corresponde a ningún formato de datos estándar.

questions.name: YANG
questions.question: Which two elements are core building blocks used to structure a YANG data model? (Choose two.)

options.A: Container
options.B: Method
options.C: Leaf
options.D: Class

questions.explanation_es: YANG organiza los datos usando "container" para agrupar nodos relacionados y "leaf" para representar un valor de dato individual. "Class" y "method" son conceptos de programación orientada a objetos y no forman parte de las construcciones propias del modelado YANG.

questions.name: APIs Catalyst Center
questions.question: When authenticating to obtain a token from the Cisco Catalyst Center (DNA Center) API, which HTTP request method is required?

options.A: PUT
options.B: GET
options.C: PATCH
options.D: POST

questions.explanation_es: La API de autenticación de Catalyst Center requiere un método POST hacia el endpoint de token, ya que se está creando una nueva sesión de autenticación, y no simplemente consultando datos existentes como haría un GET.

questions.name: APIs Catalyst Center
questions.question: What authentication method does the Cisco Catalyst Center Token API rely on to issue an authentication token?

options.A: An unauthenticated open API call
options.B: Basic authentication with a base64-encoded username and password
options.C: SSH public-key authentication
options.D: A pre-shared X-Auth-Token header sent before any login request

questions.explanation_es: La API de token de Catalyst Center usa autenticación básica HTTP, en la que el usuario y la contraseña se codifican en base64 y se envían en la solicitud inicial para obtener el token que se usará en las llamadas posteriores.

questions.name: Orquestación agent vs agentless
questions.question: Which statement accurately compares CLI-based configuration to automation tools when managing a large number of network devices?

options.A: CLI-based configuration becomes slower and more error-prone as the number of devices increases, which is why automation tools are preferred at scale.
options.B: Automation tools cannot interact with any device that is also managed through the CLI.
options.C: The CLI and automation tools apply configuration through completely incompatible protocols that can never coexist.
options.D: Configuring devices individually through the CLI scales efficiently as the device count grows.

questions.explanation_es: A medida que crece el número de dispositivos, configurarlos uno por uno mediante la CLI se vuelve lento y propenso a errores humanos; por eso se prefieren las herramientas de automatización, ya sean basadas en agente o sin agente, para operar a gran escala.

questions.name: Orquestación agent vs agentless
questions.question: Which three of the following automation tools operate in an agentless fashion, without needing persistent software installed on the managed device? (Choose three.)

options.A: Chef
options.B: Salt SSH
options.C: Ansible
options.D: Puppet Bolt

questions.explanation_es: Ansible, Puppet Bolt y Salt SSH se comunican por SSH sin necesidad de instalar un agente permanente en el dispositivo administrado, a diferencia de Chef, que requiere el agente chef-client instalado localmente en cada nodo.

questions.name: Orquestación agent vs agentless
questions.question: Which two of the following are native components used to structure an Ansible automation project? (Choose two.)

options.A: Manifests
options.B: Recipes
options.C: Tasks
options.D: Playbooks

questions.explanation_es: Ansible organiza la automatización en playbooks, archivos YAML que describen el estado deseado, compuestos a su vez por tasks individuales. Los manifiestos pertenecen a Puppet y las recipes pertenecen a Chef.

questions.name: Orquestación agent vs agentless
questions.question: Which two configuration management tools are implemented primarily in Python? (Choose two.)

options.A: Chef
options.B: Ansible
options.C: Puppet
options.D: SaltStack

questions.explanation_es: Ansible y SaltStack están escritos principalmente en Python, mientras que Chef y Puppet están construidos sobre Ruby.

questions.name: Orquestación agent vs agentless
questions.question: Chef recipes and cookbooks are primarily written using which programming language?

options.A: Ruby
options.B: Tcl
options.C: Python
options.D: Go

questions.explanation_es: Chef utiliza un lenguaje de dominio específico basado en Ruby para escribir sus recipes y cookbooks, a diferencia de Ansible o SaltStack, que están basados en Python.

questions.name: Orquestación agent vs agentless
questions.question: Which statement correctly describes the syntax used in an Ansible playbook file?

options.A: Playbooks are written in YAML and conventionally begin with three dashes (---) at the top of the file.
options.B: Playbooks are written in JSON and require curly braces to enclose every task.
options.C: Playbooks must be compiled into XML before Ansible can parse them.
options.D: Playbooks use a proprietary binary format that cannot be edited as plain text.

questions.explanation_es: Los playbooks de Ansible se escriben en formato YAML y, por convención, comienzan con tres guiones (---) al inicio del archivo para indicar el comienzo de un documento YAML.

questions.name: Orquestación agent vs agentless
questions.question: Which command correctly runs an Ansible playbook named ConfigureInterface.yaml?

options.A: play ansible-book ConfigureInterface.yaml
options.B: ansible-run ConfigureInterface.yaml
options.C: ansible-playbook ConfigureInterface.yaml
options.D: ansible ConfigureInterface.yaml

questions.explanation_es: El comando ansible-playbook es el que se utiliza para ejecutar un archivo de playbook en YAML; el comando ansible simple se usa para ejecutar módulos ad hoc individuales, no playbooks completos.

questions.name: Orquestación agent vs agentless
questions.question: Which two of the following automation tools rely on a persistent agent installed on the managed device in their standard mode of operation? (Choose two.)

options.A: SaltStack (Salt minion)
options.B: Chef
options.C: Salt SSH
options.D: Ansible

questions.explanation_es: En su modo estándar, SaltStack utiliza un agente llamado minion instalado en cada dispositivo administrado, y Chef requiere el agente chef-client. En cambio, Ansible y Salt SSH operan sin agente, comunicándose directamente por SSH.

questions.name: Métodos HTTP
questions.question: In the context of RESTful APIs, what does the acronym CRUD represent?

options.A: Create, Retrieve, Update, Delete
options.B: Create, Receive, Upload, Delete
options.C: Create, Restore, Upload, Download
options.D: Create, Read, Update, Delete

questions.explanation_es: CRUD corresponde a las cuatro operaciones básicas de manejo de datos: Create, Read, Update y Delete, que típicamente se mapean a los métodos HTTP POST, GET, PUT o PATCH, y DELETE respectivamente.

questions.name: Métodos HTTP
questions.question: Which HTTP status code indicates that a request failed because the client was not authenticated?
questions.explanation_es: El código 401 Unauthorized indica que la solicitud no incluyó credenciales de autenticación válidas. El 400 corresponde a una solicitud mal formada, el 404 a un recurso no encontrado y el 201 a la creación exitosa de un recurso.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: Cisco IOS platforms that support Python allow scripts to run in which two general modes?

options.A: Sandbox mode and privileged mode
options.B: Compiled mode and bytecode mode
options.C: Kernel mode and user mode
options.D: Interactive mode and non-interactive (scripted) mode

questions.explanation_es: Cisco admite Python en modo interactivo, donde los comandos se ejecutan uno a uno desde un intérprete, y en modo no interactivo o por script, donde se ejecuta un archivo completo de código. Las demás opciones no son términos que describan los modos de Python en plataformas Cisco.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: In Python, what does the type() function return when called on a variable?

options.A: The number of bytes the variable occupies on disk
options.B: The current memory address of the variable
options.C: The data type (class) of the object referenced by the variable
options.D: A Boolean indicating whether the variable has been initialized

questions.explanation_es: La función type() devuelve el tipo de dato, o clase, del objeto al que hace referencia la variable, por ejemplo str, int, list o dict. No indica la dirección de memoria, el tamaño en disco ni si la variable fue inicializada.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: True or false: Python is a suitable language for scripting network troubleshooting tasks and for reacting to network events.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: Python es adecuado para tareas de solución de problemas de red, uso general, acciones basadas en eventos y otras operaciones de DevOps, gracias a su sintaxis sencilla y a su amplio soporte de bibliotecas.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: Which built-in Python data structure stores data as key/value pairs, allowing a value to be looked up by its key?

options.A: Tuple
options.B: Dictionary
options.C: String
options.D: List

questions.explanation_es: El diccionario es la estructura de datos de Python que asocia claves con valores y permite buscar un valor a partir de su clave. Las cadenas, las listas y las tuplas no funcionan como pares clave/valor.

questions.name: Python básico
questions.question: True or false: The term 'native' or 'onboard' Python refers to a Python interpreter that runs directly on the switching platform itself, such as on a Catalyst 9000 switch.

options.A: True
options.B: False

questions.explanation_es: Python nativo, u onboard, se refiere al intérprete de Python instalado directamente en la plataforma de switching, como el Catalyst 9300, sin necesidad de un sistema externo.

questions.name: Python básico
